jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Crewmeister ist die führende Lösung zur Zeiterfassung und Schichtplanung von kleinen Unternehmen. Mit unserer Software unterstützen wir über 20.000 Kunden, das Stundenzettel-Chaos zu überwinden. Die Basis für unseren Erfolg sind unsere mehr als 60 Mitarbeitenden, die mit Herzblut, Neugier, Analytik und einer Menge Grips unsere Kunden mit unserem Produkt noch erfolgreicher machen.

Bewirb dich dich bei uns als Product Owner, lerne von den Besten und mache unsere Erfolgsgeschichte zu deiner Erfolgsgeschichte.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich:

Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase wirst du immer mehr zu einem wichtigen Treiber unserer Produktvision. Das bedeutet für uns:

  • Du bist neugierig und bestrebt, die Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen unserer Kunden zu verstehen und verfolgst unermüdlich die bestmögliche Lösung für sie.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Entwicklungsteam zusammen, um Produktideen in die Realität umzusetzen. Dabei beginnst du mit dem Verstehen der Anforderungen und bietest kontinuierliche Unterstützung während der Implementierung. So stellst du sicher, dass unser Team ein klares und umfassendes Verständnis des Projekts und der Kundenbedürfnisse hat.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den Erfolg des Produkts: Gemeinsam mit dem Team erstellst du User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien, priorisierst Aufgaben und pflegst den Backlog. Dabei achtest du darauf, dass das Team an den wirklich wichtigen Dingen arbeitet.
  • Du triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen, um eine reibungslose Produktimplementierung sicherzustellen, und fungierst als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen dem Produkt- und dem Entwicklungsteam.
  • Du hältst dich stets über offene Fehlerberichte sowie die Herausforderungen der Kunden und Stakeholder auf dem Laufenden.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem aktuellen Product Owner und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um unsere Produkt-Roadmap zu verstehen und aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Releases unserer mobilen App(s).

Erforderliche Qualifikationen:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium oder Ähnliches.

  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung.

  • Du hast 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Projektmanagement- oder Produktorganisation-Rolle.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im DACH-Markt.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit einem Software- oder SaaS-Produkt.

  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen in einem kleinen Unternehmen gesammelt.

  • Du hast eine unerschöpfliche Neugier auf Technologie und das Verständnis der Benutzerbedürfnisse und strebst ständig nach Verbesserungen.

  • Du bist mit agilen Werten sowie der Kanban- und Scrum-Methodik vertraut.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Schreiben von User Stories und im Aufteilen von Epics in nützliche Einheiten.

  • Du bist schnell auf den Beinen und hast eine analytische, datengetriebene Denkweise.

  • Du bringst ausgezeichnete Organisationsfähigkeiten und ein gutes Auge für Details mit.

  • Du hast starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und sprichst fließend Englisch.

  • Du sprichst sicher Deutsch (Niveau C1), da du auch mit Kunden interagieren wirst.

  • Echte Verantwortung & große Freiheiten, um zusammen mit unserem internationalen Team einen bedeutenden Unterschied zu bewirken.

  • Home-Office-Flexibilität: Maximiere deine Performance indem du von dort aus arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist.

  • Modernes Office im Werksviertel Start-Up Hub, mit hauseigenen Barista.

  • Coole Teamaktivitäten und Events

  • Benefits wie: Essensgutscheine, JobRad, Fitnessstudio-Rabatte, Freikarten, MacBook, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket

Bei uns erhältst du nicht nur die Sicherheit eines finanzstarken Konzerns, sondern auch die Unternehmenskultur und Aufstiegschancen eines Start-ups.

Bei Crewmeister geht es nicht nur um den Job, sondern um dich und dein Potenzial, um einen wirklichen Unterschied zu machen. Zeig uns, wer du bist – überzeuge uns mit deinem Lebenslauf und später im persönlichen Gespräch.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich vielleicht schon ganz bald in unserer Crew willkommen zu heißen!

Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Quantum Research
jobs.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager – Advanced Technology Programs to lead large-scale, strategic technology and R&D programs involving multiple technical disciplines, internal teams and external partners.

You will operate at the intersection of technology, engineering and program execution, turning ambitious technical objectives into structured and executable programs.

You will coordinate programs involving disciplines such as quantum physics, integrated photonics, semiconductor technologies, electronics, optics, hardware engineering, software and algorithms, while ensuring alignment between technical performance, schedule, resources, budget and contractual commitments.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have managed large and technically complex programs in demanding engineering environments such as space, aerospace, defense or semiconductors, where successful delivery requires coordinating multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, industrial partners, research organizations and institutional stakeholders across several countries.

This is a senior individual contributor / program leadership position requiring both technical credibility and strong execution capabilities. You will not be expected to be the scientific expert on every topic, but you must be able to understand complex technical dependencies, challenge assumptions, structure decisions and create the conditions for engineering teams to deliver.

Key responsabilities

** Lead Complex Technology Projects

Take end-to-end ownership of strategic R&D and technology projects, from initial framing through development, integration, validation and final delivery.

Translate high-level scientific, product or business ambitions into clear program objectives, work packages, milestones, interfaces and measurable deliverables.

Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, budget, dependencies and critical paths.

Establish program governance and ensure effective decision-making across technical teams and senior stakeholders.

Monitor progress against milestones and proactively identify deviations, bottlenecks and dependencies requiring management attention.

Drive recovery plans when projects deviate from their original objectives, including prioritization, resource reallocation, scope adjustment or technical replanning.

** Manage Technical complexity & interfaces

Coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning quantum physics, photonics, semiconductor technologies, optics, electronics, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, software and algorithms.

Work closely with technical leads to identify critical interfaces and dependencies between subsystems and workstreams.

Challenge project assumptions and ensure that technical decisions are translated into clear consequences for performance, schedule, cost and risk.

Support the transition from research and scientific proof-of-concept to engineering development, prototyping, integration, qualification and demonstrators.

Ensure that technical maturity, integration readiness and project risks are visible and understood at program level.

** Coordinate Internal & External Stakeholders

Act as a central coordination point between Quandela teams, industrial partners, suppliers, research institutions and institutional stakeholders.

Lead technical and programmatic exchanges involving stakeholders with different scientific, engineering and business perspectives.

Coordinate activities across multiple teams, organizations, sites and countries, ensuring clear ownership and effective information flow.

Manage expectations and commitments with external partners while protecting Quandela's technical, contractual and strategic interests.

Prepare and lead program reviews, steering committees and executive-level project updates.

** Risk, Budget & Delivery Management

Establish and maintain structured risk and opportunity management, including technical, schedule, supply-chain, financial and organizational risks.

Own or contribute to program budgets, resource forecasts and capacity planning.

Define and monitor relevant KPIs covering delivery, technical maturity, cost, schedule and risk.

Anticipate critical-path issues and implement mitigation plans before they impact major milestones.

Create a strong culture of accountability, transparency and fact-based decision-making across programs.

** Governance, contracts & compliance

Ensure high-quality program documentation, traceability and reporting. Coordinate contractual deliverables and reporting for strategic partnerships and publicly funded programs where applicable.

Work with relevant internal stakeholders on IP, confidentiality, export-control, security and contractual matters.

Contribute to improving Quandela's project and program management methodologies as the organization scales.

Requirements

Education

You have graduated from a top-tier engineering school or university in engineering, physics or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.

A PhD in physics, photonics, quantum technologies, semiconductor technologies or a related engineering field is a strong asset, particularly when combined with substantial industrial program-management experience.

Experience

You bring approximately 10+ years of professional experience, including significant responsibility for complex technology or engineering programs.

You have demonstrated experience leading large-scale, multidisciplinary projects with significant technical complexity, multiple interfaces and demanding delivery objectives.

Experience in one or several of the following industries is particularly relevant:

  • Space / aerospace
  • Defense
  • Semiconductors / microelectronics
  • Advanced photonics or optics
  • Complex scientific instrumentation
  • Other high-tech environments combining hardware, software and advanced engineering

You have worked with multidisciplinary and international stakeholders, including engineering teams, scientists, suppliers, industrial partners, research institutions and/or public organizations.

You can demonstrate concrete examples of programs for which you managed significant scope, budget, resources, milestones, risks and external dependencies.

Technical & Program Management Capabilities

You have sufficient technical depth to understand complex engineering discussions, challenge project assumptions and identify critical technical dependencies without replacing subject-matter experts.

You are comfortable managing projects from early-stage R&D through engineering development, prototyping, integration and validation.

You have strong command of project/program management practices including WBS, planning, critical-path management, risk management, resource planning, budget management, change management and project governance.

Experience with PMI/PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or hybrid methodologies is valued, but demonstrated delivery experience matters more than certification alone.

Experience with publicly funded, governmental or collaborative R&D programs is an advantage.

Previous quantum-computing experience is not mandatory. Experience in quantum technologies, photonics or semiconductor technologies would nevertheless be a strong asset.

Leadership & Mindset

You combine a strong engineering mindset with the ability to operate at program and strategic level. You are comfortable challenging senior technical stakeholders while maintaining constructive and fact-based discussions.

You know how to bring structure to environments where technical uncertainty is high and not all answers are available at the beginning of a project.

You can distinguish between issues requiring deep technical investigation and those requiring pragmatic decisions to maintain momentum.

You communicate effectively with both highly specialized technical teams and executive stakeholders.

You are comfortable operating in an international, multidisciplinary and rapidly growing deeptech environment.

Professional fluency in English is required.

Benefits

  • Flexible working environment, with the position primarily based at our Massy (Paris-Saclay) office to support close collaboration with the teams. 
  • Profit-sharing and a company savings plan.
  • Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car).
  • Fully covered health insurance (Alan).
  • Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate)
  • Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib).
  • Meal subsidies (Swile).

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (45')
  • Hiring Managers Interviews (45' - 60')
  • Reference checks
  • Technical discussion and presentation of previous technical project management work
  • Offer

Beyond That:

At Quandela, we value intellectual diversity, curiosity and initiative. If you're passionate about quantum algorithms, fault-tolerant quantum computing and the future of large-scale quantum applications, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't meet every listed requirement.

Job Title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:

  

  • Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. 

  • Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks. 

  • Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary. 

  • Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues. 

  • Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency. 

  • Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines. 

  • Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders. 


  • Master's degree in project management or related technical field required. 

  • Background in Electronics/Electricals

  • Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred. 

  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods 

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others. 

  • 3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations 

  • Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success. 

  • Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis 

  • A creative mind that can think outside the box. 

  • Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.

jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏠 Where you’ll fit in: The Delivery Team

We have been licensing Kraken since 2019. Throughout this time, the Delivery team has been at the forefront of industry-leading migrations, setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. These transformations go far beyond technology: we work with clients to rethink their operating models and ways of working, while continuously making the most of Kraken's evolving capabilities.

Client Delivery sits at the heart of Kraken’s transformation journeys, at the intersection of our clients and the product and engineering teams building Kraken 🚀 We lead conversations around our clients’ most important needs, help them unlock the value of Kraken and turn complex challenges into opportunities to evolve the platform, keeping Kraken innovative, relevant and ahead of where the energy market is going.

It’s a high-impact, hands-on team where you’ll influence both how our clients transform and what Kraken becomes next 💡 You’ll work alongside other Client Delivery Leads (across the same client and areas of expertise) as well as Transformation Directors and Technical Programme Leads, bringing together the right perspectives to challenge thinking, drive change and deliver the best possible outcomes for our clients.

🚀 What you'll own

  • As a Client Delivery Lead you will be at the forefront of the transformation journey with our clients.

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners).

  • You will have full ownership of a domain or product area for your client and act as a key point of contact for technology development and issue resolution within your domain or product area.

  • You will build a deep understanding of Kraken, as well as client needs and priorities, to provide expert advice and identify the best solutions, balancing the use of existing Kraken capabilities with the need for custom-built solutions.

  • You will triage and prioritise incoming requests, clearly articulating client needs, priorities and timelines to the right Kraken teams to support effective delivery and the ongoing development of the platform.

  • You will work closely with product managers and developers to translate client needs into clear priorities and support the delivery of product features.

  • You will challenge clients to think differently about technology development, championing Kraken's iterative approach and shared platform over bespoke solutions.

  • You will be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Strong client delivery, product ownership/management experience, including client-facing (often senior) stakeholder management.

  • Experience managing technology products, migration/implementation projects or complex delivery in an agile environment.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex client needs into clear action-plans and impactful solutions.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge traditional ways of thinking and drive change

  • Experience navigating complex delivery pipelines, competing priorities and changing environments.

  • A proactive, adaptable and hands-on mindset, willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, frequently flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organization.

  • Resilience and empathy, staying positive and persistent through challenges while understanding the human impact of transformation and supporting clients through change with patience and sensitivity.

  • We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open-minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever-changing environment.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Consulting experience.

  • Experience with large-scale technology transformations, migrations or enterprise platforms.

  • Experience in energy, utilities or another regulated or complex industry.

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. jobs.description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to join our Applied AI team to lead data programs that help improve automatic speech recognition (ASR) for low-resource and long-tail languages—making speech technology more accurate and accessible for communities underserved by existing AI systems.

Four-month fixed-term contract, requiring 4–6 hours per day, with potential for extension.

You will own end-to-end program delivery, bringing together multilingual teams, language expertise, and technical capabilities to meet customer goals. This is a high-ownership, outcomes-driven role with accountability for quality, timelines, and budget, and the opportunity to build scalable approaches to complex AI data challenges.

This role requires high cross-functional aptitude and a singular focus on getting things done. Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate a history of making significant demands of a business and aligning stakeholders to a project’s success.

Key Responsibilities

1. Program and Volume Delivery

  • Delivery planning: Own end-to-end program plans, from pilot and calibration through scaled production and final delivery, aligning scope, staffing, and milestones with customer requirements.

  • Tracking and forecasting: Monitor output against volume and timeline targets, forecast delivery using actual performance, and adjust capacity or workflows to address gaps.

  • Program milestones: Lead readiness reviews, quality checkpoints, and acceptance milestones, coordinating stakeholders and driving timely decisions.

  • Budget and margin: Manage delivery costs against budget and margin targets; proactively flag scope changes, cost pressures, and resource trade-offs.

2. Team Leadership and Capacity Building

  • Build and lead teams: Assemble multilingual delivery teams with the expertise needed for complex AI data programs.

  • Align capacity: Align team capacity and capabilities with program goals.

  • Enable performance: Foster strong performance through clear expectations, training, and feedback.

3. Quality and Data Handling

  • Drive data quality: Ensure AI datasets meet customer standards and support meaningful improvements in model capabilities.

  • Lead continuous improvement: Collaborate with language experts, Quality, and Research to improve data consistency and delivery performance.

  • Uphold responsible data practices: Maintain high standards for privacy, confidentiality, and secure handling of customer data.

4. Reporting and Stakeholder Communication

  • Build customer trust: Serve as a key delivery contact alongside the account team, aligning expectations and maintaining strong customer relationships.

  • Communicate program performance: Translate progress, risks, and trade-offs into clear, actionable updates for customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Drive alignment and decisions: Bring cross-functional teams together to resolve issues, manage changing requirements, and keep programs moving toward shared goals.

5. Tooling and Process

  • Partner with Engineering: Translate program needs into tooling and automation improvements that enable efficient, high-quality AI data delivery.

  • Build for scale: Develop reusable processes and playbooks that capture lessons learned, accelerate future launches, and strengthen delivery across language programs.

Qualifications

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Experience: 3+ years managing high-volume, deadline-driven service delivery in data annotation, transcription, localization, content operations, BPO or a comparable field.

  • Team leadership: Demonstrated success leading distributed teams to meet demanding delivery and quality goals.

  • Analytical skills: Strong ability to use data, dashboards, and forecasting to guide decisions on delivery, quality, and cost.

  • Quality: Working knowledge of quality assurance for AI training data, including evaluation, sampling, and acceptance criteria.

  • Communication: Excellent written English and the ability to write unambiguous instructions for multilingual contributors.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable bringing structure to ambiguous requirements and leading programs in evolving environments.

  • Availability: Able to commit for the full contract term.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Audio data: Experience with speech or audio datasets, ASR training data, or transcription.

  • Global delivery: Experience building or managing multilingual teams across international markets.

  • Data stewardship: Experience delivering programs with privacy, confidentiality, and secure data-handling requirements.

  • Tools: Familiarity with annotation platforms and Jira.

  • Languages: Fluency in an additional language; experience working with low-resource languages is a plus.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.


Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.


Why join us?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
Still unsure about why joining us?
  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
Let’s make the invisible visible!


What will you do

  • Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.
  • Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.
  • Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.
  • Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.
  • For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.
  • Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.
  • Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.


What is expected of you

  • Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.
  • A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.
  • The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.
  • Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.
  • Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.
  • We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.
Additional experience we value:
  • Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).
  • Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).
  • Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).
  • A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.


Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.
  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.
  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.
  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.
  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.
  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Hardware & Edge AI (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
New Challenge

About Us
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a defence technology company with offices in Berlin and Munich, and a trusted partner of the German Armed Forces. Our customers field sensors, drones and C2 systems from many vendors that were never built to work together. We build Hydris, an orchestration layer that integrates the systems they already field, and the ones they'll add next, into one picture operators can act on across defence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Hydris runs at the edge, keeps working when the link drops, and its core is open source under Apache 2.0.

As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field. 

You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments.

What you'll do
Discovery and requirements

  • Spend time with end users in their operating environment to understand their workflows in depth, not just their stated requirements.
  • Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication.
  • Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution.
Roadmap and delivery
  • Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines.
  • Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them.
  • Prioritize investment across the device family, deciding where to extend existing devices and where a new one is needed.
Systems and interoperability
  • Make sure devices integrate with Hydris as and interoperate with third-party systems through industry standards and protocols.
  • Design provisioning, commissioning and deployment workflows that are simple and reliable in the field.
  • Investigate issues that span hardware, firmware and communications, and work with engineering to resolve them.
Collaboration
  • Act as the main source of product context and the product's champion, making sure the team, leadership and customers understand what we're building and why.
  • Work in a product trio with engineering (hardware and ML) and design. 
  • Partner with Program and Capture Managers to keep the product vision aligned with contractual commitments.
  • Write clear PRDs and decision records, and mentor teammates on discovery practice and hardware–software trade-offs.

You should apply if you have
  • 5+ years of product management experience with hardware–software products, for example in embedded systems, IoT, robotics, defence systems or edge AI.
  • Experience taking a connected hardware product from EVT/DVT through production into operational use, including in-field updates.
  • Experience running product development end to end, from discovery to engineering-ready work, and the ability to adapt to however a team works.
  • Ability making decisions with incomplete information, and the judgment to know when a decision is risky enough to slow down.
  • Clear communication with hardware engineers, ML researchers and operators alike.
  • Motivation to contribute to European security and sovereignty.
  • Willingness to travel regularly to military exercises, test ranges and customer sites in Germany and NATO partner countries, sometimes in demanding field conditions.
  • Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2).
  • Fluency in German and English (C1 or higher).
You'd be a particularly great fit with
  • A degree in electrical, mechanical or systems engineering, robotics or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience bringing hardware products from prototype to production.
  • Experience in military, public safety or other mission-critical operational environments.
  • Exposure to sensor fusion, mesh networking or degraded RF environments, including familiarity with interoperability standards such as Cursor on Target, SAPIENT, ONVIF or ASTERIX.

We Offer
  • Direct feedback from the field: you'll see the products you build tested in real operating environments by the people who use them.
  • Prime Berlin-Mitte location – right between Alexanderplatz and Hackescher Markt.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership, and flat structure.
  • Annual €1500 Learning & development budget  (available after probation).
  • Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
  • 30 days of paid time off.

Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Driver
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Team

Our Product team works at the intersection of AI research, engineering and customer needs to shape the future of autonomous driving at Wayve. We define product direction, translate complex technical capabilities into clear roadmaps, and bring cross-functional teams together to turn research into products that deliver real-world impact.

Working closely with engineers, researchers, programme managers and automotive partners, we balance long-term ambition with practical delivery. We combine technical depth with product judgement, listen carefully to our customers and teams, and create alignment around what to build, why it matters and how we’ll measure success.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Lead a cross-functional team of engineers, researchers and PMs without formal authority. Give them clarity, remove blockers, and motivate them through hard, ambiguous problems.

  • Engage deeply with technical detail across AI / ML, autonomy and embodied AI. Debate trade-offs credibly with senior researchers and engineers, and bring structured thinking to complex technical decisions.

  • Communicate crisply across audiences, from deep technical reviews with engineers, to executive updates with leadership, to customer-facing conversations.

  • Listen actively to engineers, partners and customers, and turn what you hear into better decisions and stronger team alignment.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Independently own a substantial work package end-to-end. Define the problem, set the strategy, sequence the work, and lead the team to ship outcomes that move the AI Driver product forward.

  • Translate R&D progress and customer needs into a clear product roadmap, sequencing capabilities to maximise impact and de-risk delivery.

  • Set, track and report on clear KPIs and milestones, and establish the operating rhythm the team needs to deliver.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You’ve independently owned a substantial work package and led a cross-functional team to deliver it. You take responsibility for outcomes and proactively work through blockers.

  • You bring strong technical depth, ideally in AI/ML, autonomy, robotics or another deep-tech domain, and can engage credibly with senior engineers and researchers.

  • You’re a careful listener and clear communicator who can motivate and energise a team through ambiguity.

  • You have a proven track record in product management, technical programme management or a similar role working on complex, cutting-edge technical products.

  • You work autonomously, exercise sound judgement and are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, then adapting as you learn.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Product Sense interview; 1 hour)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Cross-functional, domain-specific interview, presentation; 2.5 hours total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

jobs.title: Senior Bid & Project Manager /  Complex Technology Projects (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Für einen international agierenden Kunden suchen wir ab sofort einen Senior Bid & Project Manager / Complex Technology Projects (w/m/d).

Als Senior Bid & Project Manager (w/m/d) liegt der Schwerpunkt auf der Vorbereitung und Steuerung anspruchsvoller Angebote und Projekte – von der ersten Anforderungsanalyse über die Planung und Umsetzung bis zur erfolgreichen Auslieferung.

Die Position bildet eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Vertrieb, Technik, Einkauf, Lieferanten und internen Fachbereichen. Dabei steht die erfolgreiche Umsetzung komplexer Vorhaben unter Berücksichtigung von Qualität, Kosten, Zeitplan und vertraglichen Zielsetzungen im Fokus.

Der Verantwortungsbereich umfasst Projekte mit hoher technischer und organisatorischer Komplexität sowie deren ganzheitliche Steuerung und erfolgreiche Umsetzung.

Aufgaben

  • Gesamtverantwortung für die Planung und Steuerung komplexer Angebote und Projekte
  • Zentrale Schnittstelle für Kunden, interne Fachbereiche, Partner und externe Dienstleister
  • Aufbau und Steuerung von Projektstrukturen, Meilensteinen, Budgets und Ressourcen
  • Analyse von Kundenanforderungen sowie Bewertung der technischen, wirtschaftlichen und vertraglichen Rahmenbedingungen
  • Erstellung und Koordination von Kosten- und Aufwandsschätzungen gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen
  • Aufbau und Pflege der initialen Projektplanung sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Projektbasis
  • Steuerung der Projekte hinsichtlich Termin, Budget, Qualität und Leistungsumfang
  • Identifikation, Bewertung und proaktive Steuerung von Risiken und Chancen
  • Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Verhandlungen im Rahmen der übertragenen Verantwortung
  • Aktives Stakeholdermanagement auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene
  • Koordination interner Teams, Partner und Lieferanten zur Sicherstellung einer reibungslosen Zusammenarbeit
  • Unterstützung des Vertriebs bei der langfristigen Geschäftsentwicklung, beispielsweise durch Markt- und Anforderungsanalysen sowie die Entwicklung geeigneter Konzepte
  • Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Bid- und Projektmanagementmethoden
  • Identifikation von Optimierungs- und Verbesserungspotenzialen in Produkten, Prozessen und Projektabläufen
  • Unterstützung und fachliche Begleitung von Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei komplexen Angebots- und Projektsituationen
  • Weitergabe von Wissen und Durchführung von On-the-job-Trainings
  • Mitarbeit an der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der internen Prozesse und Standards im Bid- und Projektmanagement

Qualifikation

  • Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Systemzusammenhänge schnell zu erfassen
  • Sehr gutes betriebswirtschaftliches und ausgeprägtes kundenorientiertes Denken
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer Projekte und Angebote
  • Erfahrung mit öffentlichen bzw. formalisierten Ausschreibungsverfahren
  • Erfahrung in Vertrags- und Kundenverhandlungen
  • Hohe Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungskompetenz sowie ausgeprägte Ergebnisorientierung
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Risiken, Chancen, Budgets, Zeitplänen und komplexen Stakeholderstrukturen
  • Erfahrung in nationalen und internationalen Projektumgebungen
  • Eine Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung, z. B. IPMA oder vergleichbar, ist von Vorteil
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager für digitale Verwaltungsprojekte - Migration und Inneres (all genders)
jobs.description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du willst Digitalisierung dort vorantreiben, wo sie gesellschaftlich wirklich zählt? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) gestaltest und steuerst du anspruchsvolle digitale Verwaltungsprojekte rund um Migration & Inneres. Du bringst Kund:innen, Fachlichkeit und Technologie zusammen und machst aus komplexen Anforderungen digitale Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst anspruchsvolle IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz mit besonderem Fokus auf die Fachthemen Migration & Inneres – agil oder hybrid.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit und steuerst Scope, Time, Budget, Qualität und Risiken.
  • Du arbeitest mit interdisziplinäre Projektteams, in unterschiedlichen technologischen Kontexten – von digitalen Verwaltungsleistungen und Fachanwendungen über Content- und Formular-Management-Systeme bis hin zu individuellen IT-Lösungen zusammen und sorgst für eine strukturierte und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Projekts.
  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst du interne und externe Stakeholder und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung zusammen. Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams übersetzt du die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen in tragfähige IT-Lösungen und digitale Prozesse und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
  • Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen bei Fragestellungen rund um die digitale Transformation und erkennst dabei auch Potenziale für die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Projekte und Lösungen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von  Entwicklungs- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten und kannst Projekte eigenständig und Ende-zu-Ende steuern.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und übernimmst sicher Verantwortung für Scope, Budget, Time,  Qualität und Risiken.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Digitalisierungsprojekten der öffentlichen Verwaltung und/oder einen fachlichen Bezug zu den Themen Migration & Inneres mit.
  • Du kennst und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Kund:innen und verstehst Projektmanagement als kundenorientierte Delivery-Rolle und bewegst dich mit deinem Kommunikationsgeschick souverän auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen der Projektorganisation.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen und/oder klassischen Projektmethoden. Erfahrung mit skalierten agilen Vorgehensweisen oder hybriden Projekt-Set-ups ist ein Plus.
  • Idealerweise verfügst du über eine relevante Projektmanagement- oder Agile-Zertifizierung, z. B. PRINCE2, PMI, Scrum PSM/PSPO
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium bildet die fachliche Grundlage für deine Tätigkeit bei uns.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
 
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.


Recruiter

Anne Kroll

jobs.title: [Job-32154] Data Product Manager (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


We are looking for a Data Product Manager to join our team in the UK. This role sits at the intersection of business, product, data and engineering, helping turn complex business needs into clear, actionable product direction.

Your Mission

As a Data Product Manager, you will own and evolve data-focused products, working closely with business stakeholders, Application Engineers, Data Engineers and Data Scientists.

A key part of your role will be navigating complex business environments, understanding different stakeholder needs and turning complex requirements into a clear and prioritized product roadmap that can be delivered over the coming months.

You will also bridge the gap between business and technology, going deeper into functional and non-functional requirements and helping translate them into clear technical requirements and user stories for engineering teams.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own, define and continuously evolve the product roadmap for data products and initiatives.

  • Understand complex business problems and translate them into clear product requirements and priorities.

  • Deep dive into functional and non-functional requirements and help translate them into technical requirements for engineering teams.

  • Partner closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Application Engineers.

  • Prioritize initiatives based on business value, technical dependencies and product objectives.

  • Work with engineering teams to ensure requirements are clear, feasible and aligned with the overall product strategy.

  • Use data and SQL to independently investigate and validate information when needed.

  • Manage different stakeholder expectations and create clarity in complex business environments.

  • Work within Agile/Scrum teams to support the continuous delivery and evolution of the product.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager working with data products, BI/analytics products, data platforms or data infrastructure.

  • Strong experience owning and managing a product roadmap.

  • Ability to navigate complex business environments and turn multiple or ambiguous requirements into clear priorities and deliverable plans.

  • Strong understanding of data ecosystems and application development.

  • Ability to translate business needs into functional, non-functional and technical requirements.

  • Hands-on SQL knowledge, with the ability to independently validate and explore data.

  • Experience working directly with Application Engineers, Data Engineers and/or Data Scientists.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ML/AI model deployment or MLOps.

  • Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI.

Working Model

This is a UK-based hybrid position, with an expectation of being in the office 2–3 days per week.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Core Platform
jobs.description:
About Qualifyze, 

Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,500 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts.

With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector.


Role Overview:

We're seeking a Senior Product Manager to advance our Core Platform strategy. Qualifyze has expanded its product offering in the Life Science - Supply Chain Risk Management space from Quality Audits to Risk Management applications.
We are now a multi-product value proposition and expect to add more solutions over time. For this, we need a strong core application and data platform.

In this role, you will collaborate with the technical Core Platform team, other product teams (PM, Data, Engineering), and key stakeholders. You will work alongside cross-functional teams, including BackEnd and Data Engineering, to define issues, design solutions, prioritize platform feature delivery, and ensure measurable outcomes.

We are looking for a collaborative, results-oriented candidate who aims to drive meaningful progress through impact-oriented discovery and effective delivery.


Main responsibilities:

  • Product Vision and Strategy: Define the platform vision and data ecosystem, creating a strategic roadmap aligned with customer and company goals.

  • Product Discovery: Lead continuous discovery efforts with internal and external stakeholders (including business stakeholders, client IT, and InfoSec teams). Develop and test hypotheses around the value and viability of platform, security, and data solutions. Translate findings into prototypes and architectural documentation to communicate concepts effectively.

  • Product Delivery: Guide the product delivery process from concept to adoption. Manage roadmaps, ensuring feasibility and usability. Work closely with technical data leads, core platform leads, and product managers to balance customer value with business priorities.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate Core Platform and Data teams (including engineering leads managing platform-application interfaces). Partner with PMs, Marketing, and Sales on requirements for security, identity/access management, and platform integrations. Ensure platform updates align seamlessly with user applications.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Use platform telemetry and agreed KPIs to monitor performance, track feature adoption, manage technical debt, and drive continuous improvement.

Main requirements:

  • 7+ years experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, platform, or data-focused roles.

  • Proven track record of delivering scalable core platform or data products in cross-functional environments (SaaS platform architectures, event systems, notification hubs, shared databases and services).

  • Experience working with technical teams (Engineering, Data, DevOps) and understanding of platform architecture, security, access management, APIs, and data workflows.

  • Familiarity with product discovery techniques, customer interviews, prototyping, and MVP testing.

  • Strong analytical and collaboration skills to navigate complex projects and deadlines.

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to communicate technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience in regulated industries (e.g., pharma, healthcare, compliance) is a plus Based in or open to travel to Barcelona or Frankfurt offices on a regular basis

💰 Salary 

At Qualifyze, our salary ranges are transparent internally, and we aim to follow a similar approach externally. For this role, we’re happy to share a reference point within the band: the expected salary range is around 75.000– 85.000 €, centered around the median.

Final compensation will depend on experience and performance during the process, with some flexibility within the range.

What do we offer?

  • 💰Competitive, annually reviewed compensation package

  • 🌴Country vacation package that increases with your tenure

  • 🏋🏽‍♀️Country specific benefits offering incl. private health care, fitness and meal allowances

  • 🚀Annual personal development budget to increase your impact

  • 🌎Hybrid working mode, plus up to 3 months of the year work from anywhere.

  • 💻All the best kit and tools to work effectively

  • 🎉Annual in person all company event and celebration in Europe

  • 👫Working with an exceptional team, doing some of the best work of your career

Use of AI in Our Recruitment Process:

We believe in a human-led hiring process. All applications are reviewed manually by our Talent Acquisition team, and neither Talent Acquisition nor Hiring Managers use AI to screen, filter, rank, assess, or make decisions about candidates, including during interviews and assessments. During interviews, AI may be used only to support note-taking and transcription. 

All hiring decisions are made by people!

Diversity & Inclusion at Qualifyze: 


At Qualifyze we actively support the power of diversity, uniting complementary talents and perspectives to address new challenges. Our collective strengths help us to find innovative solutions and turn difficulties into opportunities. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs and feels heard.


We are an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, disability, or age.  Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and respect, and we strive to create a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our product team. We hire senior PMs at the company level and place you where your strengths and our biggest bets meet - the revenue-cycle workflows practices run every day, the data and integration platform beneath them, our financial products, or the AI agents now working across all of it.

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Own a product domain end to end: its strategy, metrics and roadmap, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

  • Run mixed-method discovery and turn it into sharp, sequenced bets you can defend

  • Proactively find the problems worth solving in and around your domain, size them, and build the case to prioritise them

  • Drive prioritisation and delivery with engineering and design — the trade-offs, the milestones, the scope calls

  • Hold an end-to-end model of your domain and be a credible partner to engineering on it

  • Build alignment across functions and with leadership.

What you'll bring:

  • Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk

  • Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward

  • Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation

  • Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to engineering

  • You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly - so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product. As building gets cheaper, deciding what to build well becomes the job

  • Experience in data-heavy environments: data products, pipelines, and instrumentation you treat as first-class

    Strong communication. You cut complexity for any audience, including leadership, and hold alignment across teams

    5+ years of product management experience

    Professional fluency in German (C1+) and English. You'll work with practices, partners and internal teams in both, every day.

Even better if you have:

  • Built and shipped AI products and not just used AI tools, but shaped how a product learns and improves (evaluation, feedback loops, agent and tool design)

  • Worked with financial or payment products, and the regulatory and risk questions that come with them

  • Built or owned interfaces with external partners and providers — the APIs, integrations and third-party relationships they require

  • Built B2B SaaS in a regulated or less-digital vertical, healthcare especially.

Our Interview Process:

  • Recruiter screen - get the know Nelly

  • Product craft interview with one of our Product Managers

  • Case study interview with hiring manager

  • Office visit - interviews with stakeholders and product

What we offer:

  • Deutschlandticket (public transport pass covering all of Germany) or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast

  • Urban Sports Club membership, for sport and balance

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup

  • Up to 4 weeks of workation

  • A dog-friendly office with great vibes and a team that's fun to work with

  • Snacks and a fridge full of cold drinks

jobs.title: Product Owner - Customer Experience
jobs.description:
Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at, and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items delivered within hours in 15-minute windows.

How our customers shop is rapidly evolving. While our mobile app and website have long been the primary touchpoints, increasingly it also means an ongoing conversation with Maia, our proprietary AI shopping assistant already handling tens of thousands of conversations daily.

We are looking for a Product Owner to take accountability for a distinct segment of the customer journey—spanning areas across search & discovery, personalization, basket, slot choice, checkout, order tracking, substitutions, Rohlik Xtra, or Maia—and make it measurably better week after week.

Why this role is exciting

  • High-velocity deployment: Work directly with engineers who ship to production multiple times a day behind feature flags. A decision made on Monday reaches live customers by Tuesday.

  • Radical customer obsession: We prioritize decisions that deliver genuine value to the household on the other end of the order, even when they are harder for us to build.

  • AI-first environment: Build in a modern setup where product engineers and product owners use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Devin daily for fast vibe-coding and rapid prototyping.

  • Multi-market operational impact: Directly influence how a single product scales across five European markets, solving complex operational seams like out-of-stocks, substitutions, and slot capacity.

What you will own and deliver

  • Journey outcomes & metrics: Own the business and customer metrics for your agreed part of the journey, making day-to-day prioritization decisions that directly drive performance.

  • First-hand customer insights: Talk to customers weekly through interviews, home visits, customer care shadowing, and feedback channels. Turn real observations into crisp problem statements and validated backlog items.

  • Backlog management: Translate the product vision into explicit problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Make clear calls on what ships, what waits, and what gets cut.

  • Hypothesis-driven experimentation: Design A/B tests with clear hypotheses and pre-defined kill metrics. Evaluate performance independently and sunset features that fail to deliver value.

  • Hands-on analytics: Query product analytics and the data warehouse directly using SQL. Report weekly performance metrics and distinguish product impact from operational noise.

  • Prototyping & cell delivery: Embed daily with a dedicated 3–5 person engineering cell as the voice of the customer. Vibe-code early prototypes using AI tooling during requirements analysis instead of relying on static mock-ups.

  • Five-market product alignment: Balance local operational requirements across CZ, DE, HU, AT, and RO with a unified product vision, using data to justify when to build vs. when to say no.

What we are looking for

  • Product ownership track record: 3+ years owning a consumer product backlog on web or native apps as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping features with clear metrics.

  • Data-driven analytical skills: Strong SQL proficiency and experience designing and reading A/B tests. Ability to distinguish statistically significant results from noise and pair numbers with qualitative user insights.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling: Experience using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to build prototypes, along with a practical perspective on where LLMs add real value in a retail shopping funnel.

  • Stakeholder management without authority: Strong persuasion and communication skills to align engineers, design, Commercial, and Operations behind product decisions without formal reporting authority.

  • Language requirements: Fluent English is required. Conversational Czech, German, or Hungarian is a plus.

  • Experience in businesses with proprietary fulfillment and logistics (online grocery, q-commerce, food delivery, or logistics-heavy marketplaces) is a big plus. Including understanding of key metrics like substitution rates and slot fill.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Klim, we work with farmers and businesses to make regenerative agriculture a scalable and economically viable part of the food system. As a German AgriTech company, we empower farmers in improving soil health, increasing biodiversity, and capturing carbon, while generating reliable income through our platform.

Backed by €22 million in Series A funding, we are scaling our impact internationally and partnering with clients from the food and non-food industry. Since 2020, we have worked with more than 4,000 farmers across 900,000 hectares, covering more than 5% of Germany’s agricultural land.

If you are motivated by building a more sustainable food system and contributing to measurable climate impact, Klim offers the opportunity to do so at scale.

Your mission:

Own the design experience of Klim end to end, and build the AI-augmented design process that lets a small design team and product managers ship coherent, high-quality work at scale. You'll do the hardest design work yourself and raise the level of everyone who designs around you. This means it is a player/coach role with 60% hands-on design and 40% building the system and process around you.


What you'll do

Product experience:

  • Own the end-to-end experience across farmer and partner journeys, from onboarding through assessment, planning and improvement, verification and reporting and paymnet, shaping journeys and value moments with product managers, not only interfaces.

  • Design the most complex and brand-critical work, from wireframes and flows to polished, high-fidelity interaction and visual design.

  • Cut farmer effort, with a focus on "enter once, used everywhere" data capture, simpler onboarding and self-serve help.

  • Run continuous research, usability testing and A/B tests with farmers and partners, and track experience metrics (activation, task completion, time-to-value, satisfaction) with product and analytics.

AI-augmented design process:
