  • Own the canonical design system with engineering: components and page templates, with code as the source of truth and Figma kept in sync.

  • Define the handoff contract and the automated and human coherence checks, using AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, Claude Design, Figma, Storybook) and rules AI tools can follow.

  • Measure and improve the process: self-serve share, first-pass coherence, review time, engineering rework and ticket-to-design lead time.

Engineering efficiency and quality:

  • Reduce design-related rework by making requirements, states and edge cases explicit before build.

  • Govern the intake of new patterns and log any exceptions, so the system grows deliberately rather than drifting.

Coach:

  • Enable product managers to design simpler elements well within the system through templates, patterns, content rules and review.

What you bring:

  • Exceptional interaction and visual design craft, with mastery of Figma. You'll personally deliver the most complex and brand-critical work.

  • A portfolio that shows product-level impact (engagement, adoption, satisfaction), not only interface quality.

  • Proven ability to improve engagement and strong plus for experience running A/B tests and product experiments and strong research skills.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in design and delivery (e.g. Claude, Figma AI or similar), and a clear view of where they help and where they don't.

  • A track record of designing processes others adopt, coaching designers and enabling non-designers, while still doing strong hands-on work.

  • Clear communication with farmers, engineers and executives alike. Fluent English.

Nice to have:

  • German, to speak directly with farmers.

  • Experience in agriculture, climate, sustainability or other multi-sided platforms.

  • Experience with multi-language products and content design.

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Your work helps farmers move to regenerative practice and helps companies cut supply-chain emissions.

  • Ownership: you'll set how design works at Klim, with direct access to leadership and a clear influence on the product roadmap.

jobs.description:
Your mission

Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. Tenders should flow into Cosuno automatically from the systems our customers already use, and results should flow back out without anyone lifting a finger. The deeper Cosuno sits in our customers' processes, the more value we create for them.

At the same time, AI assistants like Claude and Gemini are becoming how people work. You'll launch our first MCP server so that our customers can analyze their data and operate Cosuno straight from their AI assistant.


How you'll get there:

  • Get to know our customers. Your first weeks are all about listening. You'll talk to customers and find out what it takes for our REST API and connectors to become part of their daily work. Together with Engineering, Customer Success and Sales, you'll turn those insights into a clear roadmap. You'll also set up the tracking that shows how much of our customers' work flows in through integrations.

  • Launch the first API improvements and our first MCP server. You'll shape both, write the engineering tickets and roll them out to our first pilot customers, all within your first few months.

  • Decide what comes next. Once real usage data and pilot feedback come in, you'll make clear recommendations on what to build and decide on the way forward together with our CTO and Head of Product.

  • Make integrations the norm. By the end of your first year, far more of our customers will run Cosuno connected to the tools they rely on, and you'll be the one who made it happen.

It's an ambitious plan, and that's what makes it fun: you'll see the impact of your work directly in our customers' day-to-day.

How we work:

  • Full ownership: You own integrations end to end, from the first customer conversation to the shipped feature. Engineering takes care of the implementation.

  • Close to the customer: You'll talk to customers constantly, mostly remotely, sometimes on-site across Germany.

  • Technical by nature: You'll read API docs, test endpoints yourself and discuss data models with engineers. You don't write production code.

  • AI-first: We use AI deeply in our product and in our daily work, and we expect you to do the same.

What you bring:

  • You've shaped an API from the product side. You've defined, together with customers and engineering, what a public API or integration of a SaaS product exposes: endpoints, data models, auth, permissions.

  • You're technical enough to go deep with engineers. Webhooks vs. polling, pagination, rate limits, OAuth: you can discuss trade-offs, and you test APIs yourself.

  • You find the real need. You've worked directly with customers, separated what they ask for from what they really need, and found what it takes for them to use an integration.

  • You write tickets engineers love. Clear scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a clear line on what's out of scope. You prioritize by impact, not by who shouts loudest.

  • You're fast. You ship in weeks, not quarters, and you build, learn and iterate in parallel.

  • You explain complex things simply, to a construction company's project manager as well as to internal stakeholders like our commercial teams or our management.

  • You live AI. You use LLM assistants and MCPs every day, and you've built your own automations.

  • You keep growing. You actively build your skills, and you seek and act on feedback.

  • Fluent German and English. Our customers are German construction companies who work in German. Our engineering team works in English.

  • Based in Germany and open to traveling to customers across the country.

  • Bonus points if you've helped build an MCP server that customers use, or if you know construction tech, ERP or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris).

Why us?

  • Real impact: You'll shape how an entire industry connects its software and how AI agents work with it.

  • Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average.

  • Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, with flexible working hours.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

  • A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

  • Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations with our Head of Product.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

 

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us.

 

Join us – Build the future of construction.

jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Why this role?

 

As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

  • Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

  • Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

  • Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

What You Bring

  • You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

  • You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

  • You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

  • You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

  • You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

It’d Be Awesome If You Also…

  • Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

  • Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

  • Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

  • Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

  • Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken.


You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved.

 

The opportunity

  • Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

  • Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

  • Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

  • Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

  • Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

  • Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

  • Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.

  • Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.

 

What you bring

  • Has designed and shipped consumer social experiences. Your portfolio shows your contribution to feeds, profiles, sharing, messaging, discovery, or communities—and how the experience changed after launch.

  • Has strong interaction design craft. You can explain why a flow is structured a particular way, what users will notice first, what they need to understand, and which decisions or steps can be removed.

  • Can build realistic interactive prototypes. You use Figma, code, AI tools, or a combination to make behavior tangible and testable, including transitions, empty states, and failure states.

  • Understands behavior through evidence. You can show where user research challenged your assumptions and changed a design.

  • Can own product outcomes. You can prioritize a problem, define success, interpret funnel and cohort data, and explain whether an experiment produced a meaningful improvement.

  • Understands the context of social finance. You account for how credibility, incentives, reputation, and visibility of financial activity affect what people trust and choose to share.

About the Role:

An extensible, integration-ready enterprise-grade IAM solution is integral to Camunda’s long-term strategy. As engineering manager, you will be tasked with end-to-end delivery of said solutions, and work closely with other engineering teams to ensure they are well integrated across the entire stack, making it secure, enterprise-ready, and easy to integrate at scale. You will coach and grow your team in order to deliver a high quality product within a predictable timeframe.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

What You Will Do:

Must Haves:

  • Proven track record leading medium‑to‑large delivery: you have owned 6‑month‑scale projects from inception to release, guiding 3–5+ engineers, writing solution designs and project plans, and delivering on time without micromanagement in a remote, asynchronous setting.

  • Hands-on experience either implementing or integrating IAM solutions; you understand protocols like OIDC and SAML and how they work in complex enterprise environments.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management: you translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, can speak with customers when needed, and drive decisive, low‑churn outcomes.

  • Background in product engineering for integration‑heavy B2B products (not primarily consulting), with a deep appreciation for enterprise needs around security, operability, and performance.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with workflow orchestration platforms or similar distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with Spring Security and the broader Spring ecosystem.

  • Experience implementing IAM federation.

  • Experience with clustered/distributed, eventually consistent applications.

  • Experience with L3 support/incident management.

  • Experience working in a fully remote organization.

jobs.description:
Your mission

The Senior Project Engineer role supports Menhir Photonics' continued growth, industrialization, and execution of advanced laser technology projects. It is a senior hybrid position combining approximately 60% technical project and program management with approximately 40% hands-on R&D and laser engineering. The role combines deep expertise in laser physics, ultrafast lasers, optics, nonlinear optics, and related technologies with the ability to structure, coordinate, and drive complex technical development activities involving internal teams and external partners.


Your profile

Key Responsibilities
Technical Project & Program Management

  • Plan, structure, coordinate, and execute strategic technical projects and programs, including internal development, customer projects, industrialization, collaborative research, public funding programs, and international development initiatives.
  • Define work packages, milestones, deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, decision points, and reporting mechanisms, translating high-level objectives into actionable engineering activities.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary work across R&D, laser and optical engineering, mechanical and electronics engineering, product development, industrialization, manufacturing, testing, operations, and quality-related functions.
  • Monitor progress, follow up on actions, identify risks and bottlenecks early, escalate critical issues where needed, and support mitigation plans to maintain project momentum.
  • Coordinate technical discussions, meetings, deliverables, reporting, and alignment with customers, industrial partners, suppliers, research institutions, funding organizations, and other collaborators.

Hands-On R&D & Laser Engineering

  • Contribute directly to advanced laser systems, ultrafast laser technology, optical and nonlinear optical systems, and new laser concepts.
  • Apply expertise in ultrafast laser physics, nonlinear optics and frequency conversion, resonator and optical system design, pulse propagation and characterization, laser stability and noise, and advanced optical components.Apply expertise in ultrafast laser physics, nonlinear optics and frequency conversion, resonator and optical system design, pulse propagation and characterization, laser stability and noise, and advanced optical components.
  • Analyze complex technical problems, plan and conduct experiments, interpret data, identify root causes, and implement engineering improvements.
  • Support product development and industrialization by improving robustness, reproducibility, manufacturability, and technical readiness.

Success criteria

  • Success is reflected in clearly structured projects, well-defined deliverables, effective milestone monitoring, early risk identification, strong stakeholder alignment, meaningful technical contributions, and strengthened R&D and engineering capabilities.
Skills & Experience
  • Senior technical leadership through expertise, structured coordination, mentoring, collaboration, and contribution to technical decision-making, without immediate formal line-management responsibility.
  • Strong background in physics, laser physics, photonics, optics, electrical engineering, engineering physics, or related discipline.
  • Substantial experience in laser development, ultrafast lasers, nonlinear optics, optical engineering, R&D engineering, technical project management, and complex technology development programs.
  • 10 years of industry experience required.
  • Master's degree or PhD
Languages
  • Fluent English & proficient in German required

Terms of Employment
  • Workload: 100%; maximum 5% travel
  • Working arrangements: On-site
  • Location: Headquarters in Stettbach near Zurich, Switzerland
  • Preferred start date: ASAP
Contact
If you thrive in a fast‑moving environment, enjoy creating structure, and want to make a measurable impact, this is the opportunity for you.

Please submit your application by clicking the “Apply for this Job” button below. Include your CV and a cover letter in English explaining why you are an excellent fit for this role. We look forward to receiving your application!

Applications submitted by headhunters or third parties will not be considered.


Why us?

You will be joining a fast-growing scale-up in our beautiful new office in Stettbach. Our international team values excellence, collaboration, and integrity. As we continue to grow rapidly, we are still building and refining our processes—your ideas and input will be valued as we establish best practices and streamline operations. We offer flexible working hours, a transportation subsidy, team events, a central location, modern, spacious offices with air conditioning, a cafeteria in the building, and opportunities for learning, development, and growth.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise.

We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs.

Why This Role Matters

  • Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions.

  • Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines.

  • Enterprise Deal Velocity: Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts.

Organizational Structure: The Four Domains

You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas:

  1. Application Security: Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening.

  2. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access.

  3. Compliance & Governance: DORA implementation, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), multi-jurisdiction regulatory audits, risk registry ownership.

  4. Data Protection: Solely dedicated to data protection: GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data subject rights, and statutory privacy regulatory requirements.

Core Accountabilities

1. Hands-On Technical Leadership, Engineering Integration & AI Hardening

  • Secure Coding Standards & SDLC: Establish and enforce secure coding baselines directly within engineering workflows. Ensure automated vulnerability scanning, SBOM tracking, and security gates are integrated into GitHub/GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

  • Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities.

  • AI Tooling & Pipeline Hardening: Deeply understand our AI approach and work closely with engineering to harden our systems. Personally evaluate and implement protective mechanisms—including secure AI harnesses, container sandboxing, and runtime guardrails around AI tooling and workflows.

  • Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Set strict remediation SLAs for CVEs and cloud misconfigurations. Directly arbitrate vulnerability severity, triage zero-days, and collaborate with engineering leads to ensure rapid remediation without stalling release velocity.

  • Zero Trust & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and drive our group-wide Zero Trust roadmap across AWS and GCP environments, enforcing least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and secure developer access.

2. Commercial Trust & Customer Engagement

  • Peer-to-Peer Customer Dialogue: Act as the senior technical authority in enterprise sales cycles, engaging directly with bank CISOs, InfoSec panels, and procurement leads to validate Hawk's architecture, threat models, and operational controls.

  • Accelerating Enterprise Deal Velocity: Modernize vendor due diligence by replacing reactive security questionnaires with standardized evidence packages, continuous compliance portals, and pre-packaged architectural audits that win customer confidence quickly.

  • Converting Security into a Value Driver: Turn our robust security baseline into a core sales differentiator, helping commercial teams demonstrate to prospect banks why Hawk's defense posture makes us their lowest-risk vendor.

3. Risk Registry, Compliance & Governance Leadership

  • Company Risk Registry Ownership: Act as the executive owner of the company-wide Risk Registry. Go beyond cataloging risks: prioritize exposures dynamically, secure cross-functional executive buy-in to fund and execute mitigations, and transform risk management into concrete business enablement and revenue protection.

  • Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Oversee vendor risk tiering, supply chain vetting, and continuous monitoring for third-party vendors and cloud sub-processors, executed directly through the Compliance function.

  • Audit & Regulatory Leadership: Maintain existing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs with zero major non-conformities across an expanding international perimeter.

  • DORA Implementation: Enforce end-to-end compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act—specifically ICT risk management, third-party vendor oversight, operational resilience testing, and ICT incident reporting.

  • Multi-Jurisdiction Alignment: Adapt policies proactively to meet global financial standards across the EU, UK, US, Singapore, and upcoming expansion markets.

  • Executive & Board Reporting: Translate technical cyber risks into clear business metrics (KRIs, risk heat maps, burn-down rates) for the CEO and Board of Directors.

4. Frontline Incident Response & Operational Resilience

  • First-Hand Incident Commander: Serve as the hands-on incident commander during Sev-1/Sev-2 security incidents. Lead technical investigations, root-cause analyses, log forensics, and technical debriefs directly alongside your team.

  • Breach Notification & External Escalation: Direct regulator, law enforcement, and client communications within mandatory statutory windows under GDPR and DORA guidelines.

  • Testing & Tabletop Drills: Design and execute technical red team engagements, threat-led penetration tests (TLPT), and crisis simulations with both technical engineers and the executive board.

12-Month Success Metrics:

  1. Commercial Velocity: Enterprise bank security assessments clear with zero high-severity blockers, accelerating enterprise contract closures.

  2. Proactive Risk Registry: The company risk registry is fully operationalized with executive buy-in, systematically driving down enterprise risk while supporting business expansion.

  3. Regulatory & Audit Record: DORA compliance program is operational; ISO 27001 and SOC 2 renew cleanly across all operating regions.

  4. Engineering & AI Hardening: Software supply chain security controls, secure coding standards, and AI harness guard rails are fully integrated into engineering CI/CD workflows.

  5. Resilient Team Operations: The four-person security team executes with high autonomy, defined KPIs, and high cross-functional trust across the company.

Candidate Profile:

  • Practitioner Foundations: Proven background as a hands-on security practitioner (e.g., former security engineer, AppSec specialist, cloud security architect, or technical penetration tester) who has advanced into security leadership.

  • Player-Coach Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a small team of domain experts while personally reviewing technical configurations, auditing cloud policies, or investigating an alert.

  • Commercial & CISO-to-CISO Fluency: Experience debating architecture, supply chain controls, and threat postures directly with enterprise bank CISOs and security evaluation boards to clear deal roadblocks.

  • AI & Supply Chain Defense Fluency: Ability to quickly understand our AI architecture, implement hands-on controls to harden AI tooling (including AI harnesses and sandboxing), and protect CI/CD pipelines against software supply chain risks.

  • Risk Registry Execution: Demonstrated ability to maintain a living risk registry, articulate risk trade-offs to non-technical executives, and rally engineering and commercial buy-in to remediate risks.

  • FinTech & Regulated SaaS Background: Multi-year leadership experience in a B2B SaaS, FinTech, or banking platform handling sensitive financial or transactional data under regulatory oversight (e.g., DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).

  • Technical Breadth: Strong practical understanding of AWS and GCP security primitives, container and Kubernetes security, modern IAM/SSO, API gateways, and EDR/XDR toolchains.

Bonus:

  • Industry certifications reflecting technical or managerial competence (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP).

  • Direct experience securing real-time event-streaming architectures.

  • German language proficiency (conversational or fluent) is a strong advantage.

  • Contribute to technical decision-making within your stream, including surfacing tradeoffs and risks early.

  • Participate in creating a psychologically safe and happy environment within the team and the company.

  • Experience with strongly typed languages (i.e., Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our tech stack quickly.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, and curious about how AI can improve how we build.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and understanding of secure development principles to building safe, trusted systems

  • Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer

  • Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

  • Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

  • A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice.

  • Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

  • We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

About Eye Security

 

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

 

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Senior SEO Manager (Berlin, hybrid)
jobs.description:
A little about us

  • What we're building: Kittl is becoming the AI-native, operating system for creative businesses. Most businesses don't lose on product, they lose on how they show up. We give small brands the creative firepower to look credible and get from idea to launch-ready, with no agency and no design team
  • Rapid growth: 11 million users since 2022
  • Diverse team: 120+ people from 30+ countries, with offices in Berlin and Düsseldorf and teammates working remotely
  • Truly product-led company: Engineers, Product Managers and Designers sit at the core of what we build
  • Backing: Raised ~$50M, led by IVP with Left Lane Capital and Speedinvest. IVP has also backed Figma, Slack, and Dropbox

Learn more: www.kittl.com/career

Your role at Kittl

Search is changing fast: people still use Google, but more answers happen in AI with zero clicks. Kittl needs to win both - and no one owns it yet.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Own Kittl's organic strategy - search and AI discovery together - and be the single person accountable for organic performance
  • Set the targets and report against them: non-branded organic growth, organic signups, signups sourced from AI answers, organic-to-paid conversion, indexed page growth
  • Prioritise programmatic scale over volume publishing. Our create pages and comparison pages are where the leverage sits, not a bigger blog
  • Make Kittl quotable by AI systems: structured data, extractable answers, factual specificity, and the off-site presence that shapes what models say about us
  • Write the technical SEO requirements and win engineering capacity for them in cycle planning - you'll be arguing your corner against other claims on the same team
  • Decide what to stop. Some of what we publish today is not compounding, and saying so with evidence is part of the job
  • Work with Product Marketing and Growth Marketing as well as the Engineering team to prove impact, prioritise, and scope SEO-related projects

Requirements

What you'll need

  • 5+ years owning organic acquisition at a product-led company, with results you can point to and explain - including the bets that didn't work
  • Programmatic and template-driven SEO at scale, not just editorial content planning
  • Genuinely technical: crawling and indexation, schema, server-side rendering, site architecture, page performance. You write the requirement and can tell when it's been built wrong
  • A real point of view on GEO - what actually moves visibility in AI answers, and how you'd measure it when attribution is partial at best
  • Fluent in the data: Google Search Console, GA4, and a product analytics tool
  • Comfortable being the only person in the seat. You set the strategy, defend the roadmap, and don't wait to be told what matters

Nice to have

  • A freemium or self-serve SaaS funnel where organic feeds signups rather than leads
  • Managing freelancers or agencies against a standard you set
  • A design, creative-tools or e-commerce audience
  • A headless CMS - we run Strapi

Tools you'll use

  • Ahrefs — keyword research, backlink analysis, competitor benchmarking and site audits
  • Peec AI — AI search visibility tracking: how Kittl shows up in answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini
  • Google Search Console — indexing and crawl health, sitemap monitoring, and organic performance (clicks, impressions, CTR, rankings)
  • Google Analytics 4 — organic traffic, landing page performance and conversion attribution
  • PageSpeed Insights / Core Web Vitals — page speed and technical performance monitoring
  • Google Keyword Planner — search volume and keyword demand, alongside Ahrefs
  • Our internal AI data agent — connects Search Console, BigQuery and Metabase, so you can query SEO performance alongside product and revenue data instead of in a silo

Interview process

  • Intro call with your recruiter (30 min)
  • Interview with the hiring manager (45 min)
  • A take-home challenge, built on a real problem we're facing right now, not a hypothetical
  • Challenge presentation and discussion with the hiring manager and a growth stakeholder (60 min)
  • Bar raiser interview (30 min)

You'll do well here if:

  • You pick up problems nobody assigned you. If something's broken and no one has stepped up, you're the person who does
  • You'd rather make the call and adjust than wait until you're certain. Speed is how we win
  • You want to own a domain deeply enough that people rely on your judgement in it, whether or not you manage anyone
  • You'll argue for your position and commit fully when the call goes the other way
  • You care about details other people would call excessive. We hold a higher bar than most, on purpose
  • You use AI constantly and still own every word you ship

Every new hire should raise the bar in some meaningful way, not just fill a seat. We hold to that, and it's why you'll be working with the most talented people from all over the world.

Benefits

  • Real ownership: You own what you ship, end to end. Whether you lead a team or lead through craft, we back you to work on what matters most
  • Work at the edge of AI and design: Kittl sits where AI, design and commerce meet. You'll be learning on the frontier, not reading about it
  • Work-life balance: 30 vacation days a year, plus public holidays
  • Hybrid working style: 3 days a week in our office in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, the rest of the week from home
  • Remote work: On top of that, work from anywhere in the world for up to 50 days (10 weeks) a year
  • VESOP: Enrolment in our Virtual Employee Stock Option Plan. When Kittl grows in value, you share in it
  • Lunch: Daily chef-prepared meals in the office
  • Mobility: Your monthly BVG ticket, fully covered
  • Health & fitness: Urban Sports Club M membership
  • Learning & development: Annual L&D budget for your professional growth
  • German classes: Online group courses at every level
  • Hackathons: Quarterly hackathons to experiment with new ideas, push boundaries and build the next big thing
  • Kittl Week: Each year, our global team gathers for a whole week to work, celebrate, get inspired and have fun

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin und die geplante Dauer deines Praktikums – am einfachsten über das Formular.

jobs.title: Self-Serve Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a Self-Serve PM to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative's user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

You'll own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That includes how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There's no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.

PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.

What you'll do

  • Own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, onboarding, lifecycle, and go-to-market levers to drive results

  • Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

  • Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

  • Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

  • Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

  • Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product

  • Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans

  • Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

Requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience on consumer or self-serve products

  • A track record of owning revenue, growth, or adoption outcomes and driving them across multiple levers

  • Deep familiarity with the creative space and the creators and marketers who use these tools, with a habit of bringing user insights into every product decision

  • Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end

  • Design-minded, with a high bar for quality and user experience and the ability to mock up concepts yourself

  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on how things are built and the tradeoffs involved

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort in product analytics tools to find opportunities and measure impact

  • A track record of shipping quickly and iterating based on what the data shows

  • Ownership pedigree, meaning you drive your own projects fully rather than handing off after the spec

  • Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

jobs.description:
About the Role:

The Program Manager executes Technology Capital Builds by creating tight alignment across Real Estate and Workplace Services, Corporate IT, Corporate Security and other partner teams to design and deliver technical solutions for capital build outs, including new office buildout and remodels, industrial labs, datacenters and secured facilities. This includes all low voltage, ISP connectivity, network infrastructure, audio visual, physical security and related IT scopes of work.

  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into portfolio status, key decisions, dependencies, and emerging risks.

  • Establish standards, drawing packages, specifications, and documentation that enable repeatable execution and operational consistency across the global portfolio.

  • Ensure disciplined stewardship of procurement, budgets, and vendor investments across the Capital Builds portfolio.

  • Identify and mitigate delivery risks early to protect project outcomes, business continuity, and operational readiness.

  • Ensure all systems are commissioned, documented, and transitioned to support teams with clear ownership and support models in place.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong project and program management capabilities.

  • Strong knowledge of the architectural design process (schematic design, design development, construction documents).

  • Strong knowledge of commercial real estate construction processes.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Vendor management experience (Vendor vetting, RFP and bid response, performance management, handover).

  • Ability to read construction and engineering plan drawings.

jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive III to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer, not just closing the deal in front of them. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role carries real weight. You'll be responsible for a book of enterprise accounts where the deals are complex, the buying committees are large, and the technical bar is high. There's meaningful room here to shape how your territory gets built, not just execute against someone else's plan.

As an Enterprise Account Executive III, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Build and drive strategic account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and executive buyers.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure smooth handoff after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to senior leaders and technical buyers, tailoring the pitch to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Forecast accurately and manage pipeline health with discipline, not optimism.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end, ideally six figures or more, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked deals with C-suite, IT, legal, and procurement in the room at the same time, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Strong territory and account planning instincts. You can build a plan independently, not just work from a list handed to you, and you know how to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • The ability to sell technical products credibly. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage here, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under genuine pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor, and you know what it took to earn that.

This role is an existing vacancy

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

jobs.title: Design System Director (x/f/m)
Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Strasbourg
jobs.description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Après avoir digitalisé le secteur de la beauté dans plusieurs pays d'Europe, nous recherchons nos premiers commerciaux pour faire de la France une de nos plus grandes réussites.

L'opportunité

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

Tes missions

  • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

  • Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

  • Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

  • Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

Ton profil

  • Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est

  • Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active

  • Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Strasbourg.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions)

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

n8n sits at one of the most interesting UX problems in software right now: more than 80% of workflows built on n8n today involve AI agents, and the platform is in the middle of a deliberate expansion from deeply technical developers toward a broader set of builders. That tension, keeping power users happy while dramatically lowering the floor, is the central design challenge.

This is a foundational hire with a real mandate and direct exec partnership.

What you'll do

Own the quality bar

  • Set a clear, consistent quality bar that the team can orient around and build toward, so great work becomes the natural output of how we design together.

  • Build review processes and critique rituals that give the team a shared language for quality and the confidence to make strong craft decisions together.

  • Evolve the design system and QA practices so the bar rises as the team grows.

  • Dig into one of the most genuinely interesting UX challenges in the space: n8n has historically had a steep learning curve for new users. Your job is to lower that floor without losing the power that experienced builders love.

Drive design's strategic influence

  • Shape product strategy, not just respond to it. Bring design thinking into roadmap conversations and help surface user problems before they become someone else's brief.

  • Help lead n8n's expansion toward a broader, less technical audience, a deliberate and exciting strategic shift that design should be leading.

  • Build the kind of relationships with Product, Engineering, and leadership where design is a genuine thought partner at every stage.

Build and grow the team

  • Lead a team of around 14 designers today: 2 Design Leads each working with ~6 ICs, plus Design Engineering and UX Research (with more hires ahead).

  • Shape the team structure, career framework, and progression paths so people know where they stand and where they're going.

  • Create a culture of high standards and honest feedback, where people feel supported to do their best work and have a clear sense of what great looks like.

  • Own hiring and headcount planning for the department, and help us grow without losing what makes the team good.

Build research into how we make decisions

  • Establish a pragmatic, continuous research practice from the ground up. We're making our first dedicated UX research hires, so there's real room to shape this.

  • Make customer insight, product data, and community feedback a live input to product decisions, so teams are building from evidence at every step.

  • Connect research to the decisions that matter most: activation, adoption, retention, and helping new users find their way into n8n with confidence.

Help the team work in new ways

  • Champion practical AI adoption inside the design org, from prototyping and research synthesis to design QA and workflow efficiency.

  • Help the team stay curious and current as the tools, patterns, and expectations around AI products continue to evolve fast.

  • Model the kind of working style you want to see: thoughtful, adaptive, and genuinely excited about what's changing.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🧭 Product design leadership: You have managed managers, coached senior designers, and built design teams that improve both craft and business outcomes, including making hard performance calls when needed.

  • 🧩 Complex product systems experience: You have led design across complex or developer-facing products where UX quality depends on deep product understanding.

  • 🎨 Craft authority: You are a quality bar, not just someone who appreciates quality. You can identify great work, explain why it's great, and hold the line on standards even when it's uncomfortable.

  • 📣 Strategic influence, not just strategic thinking: You have made design a co-equal in product conversations, not a downstream function. You know how to bring people with you, create debate, and drive decisions.

  • 🔀 Structured problem-solving under ambiguity: You find your way into unclear problems and create a plan. You don't just ask good questions, you answer them. You move forward when there's no map.

  • 🤖 AI-era product judgment: You understand the AI, automation, or adjacent tooling landscape and can turn emerging patterns into usable, trustworthy product experiences.

  • 🔍 Research literacy: You know how to build research into product development so insight becomes part of how teams make decisions, not a separate artifact.

  • 📊 Data-informed decision making: You use product analytics, research, and customer evidence to guide decisions instead of relying on taste or opinion alone.

  • 🧱 Org design and performance management: You can design team structures, define career paths, raise expectations, and handle difficult performance conversations with clarity.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🌱 Open-source or community product experience: You have worked on open-source, fair-code, community-led, or builder-driven products and understand what it means to design for a community that has strong opinions.

  • 💻 Design engineering credibility: You have enough front-end or design engineering fluency to partner deeply on design system adoption and implementation quality.

  • 🌍 Remote-first operating systems: You have built design rituals, critique, QA, and collaboration practices that work across distributed teams and time zones.

  • 🚀 Growth surface experience: You have worked on activation, onboarding, templates, time-to-value, or product-led growth surfaces.

jobs.description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As an Engineering Manager for the Algorithms team (Revenue Management Engine) at RoomPriceGenie, you will build and lead the team behind the core of our product: the pricing and forecasting engine that automatically prices rooms for thousands of hotels. This is the algorithmic and data heart of RoomPriceGenie, spanning the pricing algorithm, the forecasting models and the data pipelines that feed them.

This is a leadership role. Your focus is the team: delivery, people and the connection to product goals. You stay technically credible and close to the work through design and code review, and you get hands-on when the team needs it, but you are not coding day to day. You balance delivery speed with long-term technical health and build an environment of trust and accountability. The role also reaches beyond your own team: we want you leading the way on technical improvements at the Product and Engineering department level, things like engineering processes and operational excellence, as a hands-on driver.

You will work closely with a Product Manager and report to the Senior Engineering Manager. A core part of the job is turning a complex, data-heavy domain into reliable, measurable outcomes: shipping model and pipeline improvements, proving their impact through backtesting and clear quality metrics, and keeping pricing runs dependable at scale. We expect you to be a genuine partner to Product, able to challenge and shape what gets built, not only how.

Who you'll lead

You will lead a team of 4 engineers (3 Senior and 1 Staff). The role may also grow to include an Associate Engineering Manager over time.

Your Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a high-performing team across the pricing algorithm, forecasting and data pipelines, owning delivery, quality and the operational health of pricing runs.

  • Grow your people through regular 1:1s, feedback, performance reviews and career development.

  • Hire, onboard and develop engineers to keep the team balanced and strong.

  • Partner closely with Product and challenge them: push back on direction, bring your own point of view and drive changes to what the team builds, not just how it builds.

  • Translate business goals into clear engineering plans with measurable outcomes and realistic timelines. Use data (backtesting, model quality, before and after signals) to guide prioritisation.

  • Balance delivery velocity with technical sustainability, addressing debt, scalability and reliability as part of delivery rather than after it.

  • Provide technical oversight through design and code review, staying close enough to guide architecture and quality and to get hands-on when the team genuinely needs it.

  • Act as a buffer between the team and external pressure, keeping focus and healthy team dynamics.

  • Improve engineering processes and practices to increase clarity, alignment and predictable delivery.

  • Lead technical improvements beyond your own team, at the Product and Engineering department level, for example engineering processes and operational excellence. We want you hands-on and driving these, not only sponsoring them.

Your Profile

  • Strong software engineering background with a track record of building and operating production systems, ideally with depth in backend and data-intensive or algorithmic domains.

  • At least 5 years of experience, with several years genuinely managing engineers, including performance management. This is a role for an experienced manager, not a first step into leadership.

  • Experience growing or managing other managers, for example an Associate Engineering Manager or Team Leads, is a plus.

  • A strong product mindset with the confidence to challenge Product. You enjoy defining problems and validating solutions with PMs and you are comfortable disagreeing, proposing alternatives and driving them to a decision.

  • Technically credible and willing to get hands-on when the team needs it, while spending most of your time leading rather than in the code day to day.

  • Comfortable with our stack: Python/Django on the backend, with a data stack around Snowflake, dbt and Dagster. Exposure to forecasting, modelling or data engineering is a strong plus.

  • Strong grasp of system design, architecture and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication and leadership: you create clarity, trust and accountability, with a servant-leadership mindset toward your team.

  • You look beyond your own team and enjoy driving technical improvements that raise the bar across the wider Product and Engineering org.

  • Fluent in English and based in a European time zone (UTC+0 to UTC+2).

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

Luminovo builds the software that powers the electronics supply chain — and we're building out the DACH side of our Global Solutions team. As a Solutions Engineer based in Munich or Berlin, you are the technical face of Luminovo at the two moments that decide whether a customer succeeds with us.

  • Build deep expertise in the Luminovo platform and the electronics manufacturing landscape — deep enough that industry experts trust you in the room

  • Spot implementation risk early, escalate to the right people proactively, and keep projects on schedule

  • Turn what you learn into revenue-anchored feature requests and input for the Product team helping them to further improve our software.

  • You speak German fluently and work comfortably in English. You'll be in front of technical buyers every week

  • You have a technical foundation and a track record of getting deep into an unfamiliar product fast. A degree in engineering, computer science, physics, or a related field helps — so does hard evidence that you taught yourself something difficult

  • You're process-driven. You're at your best when a project has gone sideways and someone needs to draw the map

  • You're comfortable in front of customers: you can hold your own in a technical conversation with a specialist, then explain the same thing simply to a procurement lead

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. Ideally you've built your own automations, workflows, or tools — we care about what you've actually shipped, not what you've read them

  • Bonus: French language fluency

Work setup

Hybrid in Munich or Berlin. Munich is our global HQ; we also have a Berlin hub. No strict office policy, but a clear expectation of regular collaboration days with your Solutions teammates and colleagues across multiple departments.

Travel

We meet regularly for team retreats and selected industry events, so expect occasional travel. We cover the costs.

Why Luminovo

  • Join a well-funded SaaS scale-up with 300+ active customers, in the role that decides whether they succeed with us

  • One global Solutions team across Europe and the US — no EU/US knowledge silos

  • AI at the core of the product and of how we work, not a slide in a deck

  • Real ownership on a young team: define the blueprints the rest of the team runs on

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.
