jobs.title: Business Analyst KI-Prozessautomatisierung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI.

Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus: von Daten und Datenqualität über KI-Verarbeitung bis zur Integration in produktive Systeme.

Das Projekt

Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel – von Discovery und Business Analyse über PoCs und Entwicklung bis zum Live-Betrieb.

Die Prozesse, die wir automatisieren, sind oft über Jahre gewachsen. Wissen steckt in einzelnen Köpfen, Abläufe sind nur teilweise dokumentiert und Fachbereiche arbeiten mit selbst entwickelten Excel-, Access-, SharePoint- oder anderen Legacy-Lösungen.

Genau dort setzt Deine Rolle an.

Aufgaben

Die Rolle

Du verstehst, was im Fachbereich wirklich passiert – und bereitest es so auf, dass daraus ein umsetzbarer Daten- oder KI-Anwendungsfall entsteht.

Dafür arbeitest Du direkt mit Sachbearbeiter, Projektleitungen und Entscheider. Du findest heraus, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt, welche Regeln tatsächlich gelten und wie ein Prozess funktioniert. Du modellierst Abläufe und Entscheidungslogiken und machst sie für unser Delivery-Team nutzbar.

Dabei gehst Du über klassische Business Analyse hinaus: Du arbeitest heraus, auf welchen Daten ein Prozess basiert, welche Objekte und Beziehungen existieren, aus welchen Systemen die Daten stammen und was in den einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten mit ihnen passiert.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Solution Architect sowie unseren Data-, AI- und Software-Engineers zusammen. Du musst keine Datenpipeline bauen und keinen produktiven Code schreiben. Du solltest aber Datenflüsse verstehen und einschätzen können, was technisch möglich ist – und was das für den Fachbereich bedeutet.

Gleichzeitig bist Du eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Use Cases: Du gibst Statusupdates, bereitest Entscheidungen vor, managst Erwartungen und treibst offene Punkte voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Anforderungen durch Workshops, Interviews und Prozessbeobachtung herausarbeiten – auch wenn Prozesse bisher kaum dokumentiert sind
  • Ist-Prozesse sowie fachliche Regeln und Entscheidungslogiken analysieren und modellieren, insbesondere mit BPMN
  • Datenobjekte, Beziehungen, Quellsysteme und Schlüssel hinter einem Prozess identifizieren und visualisieren
  • Datenflüsse nachvollziehen und Auswirkungen von Datenqualität und Datenverfügbarkeit auf Anforderungen erkennen
  • Prozessdiagramme, Fachkonzepte, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Präsentationen erstellen
  • Stakeholder-Kommunikation und Erwartungsmanagement für Deine Use Cases übernehmen
  • Business Cases sowie KI-, Datenschutz- und Data-Governance-Freigaben beim Kunden begleiten
  • Fachliche Grundlagen für Scoping, Aufwandsschätzungen und Angebote erarbeiten
  • Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte nachhalten sowie Blocker sichtbar machen und vorantreiben
  • Gemeinsam mit dem Team prüfen, wie Lösungen auf weitere Fachbereiche oder Länder skaliert werden können

Das heutige Team

Du arbeitest in einem interdisziplinären Delivery-Team mit Solution Architecture, Data Engineering, AI Engineering sowie Backend- und Frontend-Entwicklung.

Qualifikation

Must-haves

  • Projekterfahrung in Business Analyse, Prozessberatung, Requirements Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld
  • Erfahrung in der Modellierung von Prozessen und Entscheidungslogiken, idealerweise mit BPMN
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Datenmodelle und Datenflüsse: Du kannst Objekte, Beziehungen, Quellen und Schlüssel herausarbeiten und nachvollziehen, was mit Daten in einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten passiert
  • Grundverständnis für KI und KI-gestützte Automatisierung, insbesondere hinsichtlich Datenqualität, Ergebnisqualität und der Grenzen nicht-deterministischer Systeme
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Ownership: Du bringst Themen auch ohne Weisungsbefugnis voran und kannst unterschiedliche Stakeholder sicher abholen
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher und Englisch fließend

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit Daten-, Automatisierungs- oder KI-Projekten
  • Erfahrung mit Legacy- oder Shadow-IT-Ablösungen
  • Erfahrung in regulierten oder Governance-intensiven Enterprise-Umgebungen
  • Agile Delivery-Modelle wie Scrum oder SAFe sowie Azure DevOps oder Jira
  • Kenntnisse in Telekommunikation, Infrastruktur, Vertragsmanagement oder Rechnungsprüfung
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Google Cloud oder vergleichbaren Datenplattformen

Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Attraktives Gehalt mit zusätzlicher Erfolgsbeteiligung
  • Betriebliche Weiterbildung und Entwicklung in Richtung Data & AI
  • Firmenevents & Company Offsites
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & hybrides Arbeitsmodell in Hamburg, Ruhrgebiet und München
  • Auswahl aus verschiedenen Benefits, z. B. Gym Pass oder Deutschlandticket
  • Direkter Zugang zu Fachbereichen und Entscheider beim Kunden
  • Die Möglichkeit, technisch tiefer in Daten, KI und Automatisierung einzusteigen als in vielen klassischen Beratungsrollen

Wir suchen bewusst jemanden auf Mid-Level. Du musst nicht alles am ersten Tag mitbringen. Wichtig sind Prozess- und Datenverständnis, technisches Interesse und die Bereitschaft, tiefer einzusteigen.

Bei uns kannst Du Dich Schritt für Schritt weiterentwickeln: vom Lesen von Datenflüssen zum Verstehen von Code, vom Datenverständnis zum eigenständigen Prüfen mit einfachen SQL-Abfragen oder Skripten und von klassischer Prozessmodellierung hin zu KI-gestützter Analyse und Automatisierung.

So kannst Du zunehmend tiefer in Data, AI und intelligente Prozessautomatisierung einsteigen, ohne Deine Schnittstellenrolle zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie aufzugeben.

jobs.description:
ENGLISH VERSION

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !

Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.

Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.

🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN (Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne, avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin.

Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis, reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur (https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur), en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set. Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT.

Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Une formation en mécanique numérique, mécanique des fluides, éléments finis ou calcul scientifique est recherchée.

Des compétences en C++/Python, calcul haute performance, PETSc, méthodes Level-Set ou traitement d’images 3D seront appréciées.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les capacités et aptitudes suivantes :

· Capacité à travailler en équipe

· Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs académiques et industriels

Dans le cadre de sa politique Égalité, Diversité et Inclusion, l’École des Mines de Saint Etienne est un employeur soucieux de l’équité de traitement entre les candidatures.

You own the plan, the risk assessment, and the rollback.

Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Responsable Réglementation et Conformité (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Juridique.  Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Le Responsable Réglementation et Conformité veille à ce que l'entreprise respecte l'ensemble des réglementations applicables à ses activités, produits et processus, tant au niveau national qu'international. Il garantit la conformité des collections (prêt-à-porter et accessoires, lifestyle et décoration/maison) avec les normes en vigueur, tout en intégrant les enjeux éthiques, environnementaux et sociaux sur l'ensemble des marques du groupe. Il pilote par ailleurs le dispositif de conformité corporate du groupe, en particulier la lutte anticorruption.

Missions

1. Veille réglementaire et normative

  • Assurer une veille constante sur les réglementations applicables : droit de la consommation, droit du travail, droit commercial, douanes, réglementation textile, REACH, sécurité produit, étiquetage, allégations environnementales (directive Empowering Consumers), protection des données
  • Identifier les évolutions réglementaires susceptibles d'impacter l'activité de l'entreprise (France, UE, Royaume-Uni, États-Unis, pays de fabrication et de distribution)
  • Informer les équipes internes des évolutions et les accompagner dans leur mise en œuvre

2. Conformité produit

  • S'assurer que les produits respectent les exigences légales en matière de composition, traçabilité, étiquetage, sécurité, tests laboratoires, sur l'ensemble des catégories (textile, maroquinerie, bijoux, lifestyle, décoration/maison)
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes qualité, achats, design, développement produit et supply chain afin de garantir la bonne conduite des audits de conformité et des tests produits (substances réglementées, inflammabilité, solidité, sécurité des articles enfant…)

3. Conformité corporate et lutte anticorruption

  • Piloter le dispositif de conformité à la loi Sapin II : cartographie des risques de corruption, code de conduite, dispositif d'alerte interne, procédures d'évaluation des tiers, formation des collaborateurs exposés 
  • Gérer le dispositif de recueil des signalements (lanceurs d'alerte) : réception, qualification, instruction et suivi, dans le respect de la confidentialité et des délais légaux
  • Déployer et suivre les procédures de due diligence tiers (fournisseurs, intermédiaires, agents à l'international)
  • Assurer le suivi des obligations liées au devoir de vigilance et au reporting de durabilité (CSRD), en lien avec les équipes RSE et Finance

4. Accompagnement des équipes et mise en conformité

  • Rédiger ou actualiser les procédures internes et les différents cahiers des charges (produits, matières, fournitures)
  • Former les collaborateurs aux enjeux réglementaires et de conformité (équipes design, production, marketing, supply chain, achats, finance, commerce)
  • Aider à l'accompagnement par les équipes des fournisseurs dans la mise en conformité des produits et dans le respect des standards sociaux et environnementaux de l'entreprise
  • Être le point de contact des équipes opérationnelles pour toute question de conformité, et savoir arbitrer entre exigence réglementaire et réalité business

5. Gestion des risques et reporting

  • Mettre en place des plans de prévention ; animer et mettre à jour la cartographie des risques de conformité du groupe 
  • Suivre les indicateurs de conformité et établir un reporting régulier
  • Gérer les situations liées à une non-conformité : rappels produits, litiges clients, contrôles DGCCRF, AFA, CNIL ou autorités étrangères
  • Piloter les relations avec les conseils externes sur les sujets de conformité

Requirements

  • Formation supérieure en droit (Master 2 en droit des affaires, compliance, droit de la consommation ou équivalent) ; une certification compliance est un atout

jobs.description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) lead complex end-to-end deployments of frontier models in production alongside our most strategic customers. You will own discovery, technical scoping, system design, build, and production rollout, partnering directly with customer engineering and domain teams.

You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback that changes product and model roadmaps. You’ll work closely with our Product, Research, Partnerships, GRC, Security, and GTM teams.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role you will

  • Own technical delivery across multiple deployments from first prototype to stable production

  • Build full-stack systems that deliver customer value and sharpen how we learn

  • Embed closely with customer teams, understand their needs, and guide adoption of what you build

  • Scope work, sequence delivery, and remove blockers early

  • Make trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality; adjust plans to protect delivery

  • Contribute directly in the code when progress or clarity depends on it

  • Codify working patterns into tools, playbooks, or building blocks that others can use

  • Share field feedback that helps Research and Product understand where the models succeed and where they can improve

  • Keep teams moving through clarity and follow-through

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Bring 5+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

  • Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments

  • Write and review production-grade code across frontend and backend using Python, JavaScript, or comparable stacks

  • Have built or deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behaviour affects product experience

  • Simplify complexity and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

  • Communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders

  • Spot risks early and adjust without slowing down

  • Model calm and judgment when the stakes are high

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.

  • Obsessed with quality.

  • Deliberate in our decisions.

  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description
 

As a member of one of our platform engineering squads, you will leverage your experience and expertise to design and develop cloud-based solutions. This means implementing massively scalable services, automating all system operations, measuring and continuously improving service quality, and making the lives of other developers easier. 

You will play a key role in helping our product reach its next stage of evolution and delight our users and customers. 


What you will do

  • Develop, enhance, and operate cloud solutions on AWS with a focus on automation, high performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency.

  • Take part in the definition of novel cloud solution designs and lead their development.

  • Work in sprints with other engineers (backend, frontend, SRE, and other CPEs) as part of a cross-functional team to deliver new features into production. 

  • Collaborate with other squads in Product Development and Mission Control to ensure solutions fit into the Sonar platform.

  • Contribute to your squad’s efforts in operating its services through, i.e., definition and upkeeping SLOs, investigate alarms and respond to incidents to maintain a high quality of service.


    • Experience and qualifications

    Must Have: 

  • 2+ years of experience with architecting, developing, and operating cloud solutions on AWS for Web/API applications.

  • Knowledge of AWS networking and the following core AWS services: CloudFront, CloudWatch, ECS, Lambda, RDS, andSNS, SQS. 

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with at least one of the following tools: AWS CDK (preferred), AWS CloudFormation or Terraform/OpenTofu.

  • Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C# or similar.

  • Experience with at least one scripting language such as Bash or similar.

  • Experience with on-call for operating global services.

  • Experience working in an agile environment.

  • Strong DevOps mindset.

    • Nice to have:

  • Proficiency with AWS DynamoDB or OpenSearch.

  • Proficiency with Ansible or other IaC solutions.

  • Experience with distributed application architecture and development.

  • AWS Developer Associate Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer, or other valid, relevant AWS certifications.

  • Experience with one or more programming languages such as Python (preferred), Java, or similar.

  • Experience with AI enablement platform.


    • Additional comments
    This role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. jobs.title: Graphic Designer 100% (a)
jobs.description:
Über uns

Die Hotz Group ist ein markenorientierter Partner für Wertschöpfung, der Unternehmen an strategischen Wendepunkten neue Zukunft gestaltet und aufbaut. Wir arbeiten mit Investoren, Inhabern und dem Top-Management – von unserem Hauptsitz in der Schweiz und unseren Standorten in Los Angeles, Singapur, Hamburg und Neu-Delhi.
 
Zu unseren Kunden zählen inhabergeführte Unternehmen, nationale und Hidden Champions sowie grosse internationale Konzerne.
 
Aufbau integriertes Kreativ-Team 
Wir befinden uns in einer Phase der Weiterentwicklung und bauen unsere kreativen Kompetenzen gezielt aus. Im Zuge dessen entwickeln wir ein schlagkräftiges Design-Team an der Schnittstelle von Geschäftsstrategie, Marke und Design. Das Team arbeitet künftig für alle Unternehmen der Gruppe, mehr dazu findest du auch auf https://Hotz.studio. 
 
Unser Anspruch ist es dabei, strategisches und unternehmerisches Denken mit exzellenter kreativer und gestalterischer Arbeit zu verbinden. Wir verstehen Strategie und Design nicht als getrennte Disziplinen, sondern als gegenseitige Enabler, die für Unternehmen und Marken nachhaltig Wert schaffen. Für unser Kreativ-Team suchen wir nach Kandidaten, die diesen Weg aktiv mitgestalten möchten.
 
Gemeinsames Verständnis von Zusammenarbeit
Gesucht werden Persönlichkeiten, die sich gerne in ein dynamisches Umfeld einbringen und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam mit anderen Talenten Lösungen zu entwickeln, die die Erwartungen an eine klassische Agentur übertreffen. Wichtig sind uns eine agile, unkomplizierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative sowie ein ausgeprägter Teamgedanke. Wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe – unabhängig von Funktion oder Hierarchie. Wir suchen Menschen, die offen kommunizieren, Wissen teilen, Feedback konstruktiv aufnehmen und auch andere Perspektiven aktiv einbeziehen.


Über die Stelle

Als Graphic Designer arbeitest du an Branding-Projekten, visuellen Identitäten und digitalen Anwendungen. Du entwickelst visuelle Systeme präzise weiter, wendest Marken konsistent über unterschiedliche Touchpoints hinweg an und arbeitest eng mit Art Directors, Strateg:innen und Berater:innen zusammen. Im Mittelpunkt steht deine gestalterische Qualität – gleichzeitig interessierst du dich für die Inhalte und strategischen Zusammenhänge hinter dem Design.

On-site, 1–2 Tage Homeoffice möglich


Deine Aufgaben

  • Ausarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von visuellen Identitäten, Corporate Designs und Designsystemen
  • Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Logos, Logo-Systemen, Brand Guidelines, Typografie- und Farbsystemen sowie Bildwelten
  • Entwicklung digitaler Markenanwendungen, insbesondere Websites, Responsive Designs und digitale Designsysteme
  • Gestaltung von Kommunikationsmitteln und Markenanwendungen über Touchpoints wie Web, Social Media, Kampagne, Motion und Print
  • Präzise Umsetzung von Designkonzepten und Sicherstellung einer konsistenten visuellen Markenführung
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Art Directors, Strateg:innen und Berater:innen bei der Entwicklung starker und umsetzbarer Lösungen
  • Einbringen eigener Ideen und aktives Mitdenken bei kreativen und gestalterischen Fragestellungen
  • Aufbereitung und Präsentation von Entwürfen und Varianten im Team sowie gegebenenfalls gegenüber Kund:innen
  • Aktive Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung deiner Kenntnisse in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite und neuen Design-Tools
  • Bereitschaft, dich in strategische und unternehmerische Zusammenhänge einzuarbeiten und zur Weiterentwicklung des Kreativ-Teams beizutragen


Dein Profil

  • Ca. 3–6 Jahre Berufserfahrung
  • Sehr starkes, designorientiertes Portfolio mit überzeugenden Branding-, Website- und Digitalprojekten
  • Zwingende Erfahrung im Bereich Branding, Corporate Design und Visual Identities
  • Erfahrung mit Logoentwicklung, Designsystemen, Brand Guidelines, Typografie, Farbsystemen und Bildwelten
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis dafür, wie eine Marke vom Logo und Grundsystem bis zur digitalen Anwendung funktioniert
  • Sehr sicherer Umgang mit Figma und sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Suite
  • Verständnis von Responsive Design und digitalen Designsystemen
  • Motion-/After-Effects-Kenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Hohe Kompetenz im Umgang mit AI und der Anwendung neuer KreativtechnologienInteresse an strategischen und inhaltlichen Fragestellungen sowie die Bereitschaft, das «Warum» hinter einer Gestaltung zu verstehen
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse beziehungsweise sichere Kommunikation im deutschsprachigen Umfeld
  • Gesucht wird keine reine Production-Designer-Persönlichkeit und kein:e reine:r Print- oder Editorial-Grafiker:in: Du musst Branding verstehen, digital denken und einen hohen gestalterischen Anspruch mitbringen


Unser Angebot

  • Anspruchsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Rolle mit umfassender Eigenverantwortung und grossem Gestaltungsfreiraum
  • Spannende Projekte für nationale und internationale Kunden an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Marke, Design und digitaler Transformation
  • Interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien, offener Kommunikation und direktem Austausch mit der Unternehmensführung
  • Möglichkeit, die nächste Phase der Hotz Group aktiv mitzugestalten und den Ausbau unseres Kreativ-Teams nachhaltig zu prägen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Strateg:innen, Berater:innen und Spezialist:innen aus dem Brand Leadership Circle

Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

jobs.description:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Dans le cadre du projet ANR NET4AI, qui vise à rendre les infrastructures utilisées pour entraîner et opérer des modèles d'IA générative plus efficaces (observabilité, communications collectives, efficacité énergétique), nous recrutons une post-doctorante ou un post-doctorant au sein de notre département Automatique Productique et Informatique (DAPI), équipe STACK.

 

Sous la responsabilité scientifique de Remous-Aris KOUTSIAMANIS et en collaboration avec les chercheurs, ingénieurs et partenaires du consortium Net4AI et du projet SLICES-FR, vous définirez et mettrez en œuvre une méthodologie expérimentale reproductible pour l'évaluation des mécanismes Net4AI. Vous concevrez et développerez des briques logicielles d'automatisation (notamment via EnOSlib) pour le déploiement de charges GenAI distribuées. Enfin, vous réaliserez des campagnes expérimentales et contribuerez activement aux publications scientifiques et logiciels open source du projet.

Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée


✔️ Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le langage Python ainsi que les outils de développement collaboratif tels que Git, l'intégration continue et les tests automatisés. Vous possédez également des connaissances solides en systèmes GNU/Linux, en administration système et en réseaux de datacenter, incluant le routage et les mesures de performance.

✔️ Vous avez une expérience significative dans la conception d'expériences reproductibles et vous êtes capable de monter en compétence sur des technologies spécifiques comme RDMA/RoCE.

✔️ Vous faites preuve d'une grande autonomie dans la conduite de vos travaux tout en montrant une rigueur scientifique exemplaire et un sens critique aiguisé, particulièrement concernant les limites d'une expérimentation.

🇬🇧 Vous disposez d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles en anglais scientifique et vous communiquez avec aisance, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, pour rendre compte de vos progrès au sein d'un consortium multi-partenaires.

🎓 Le profil recherché devra être titulaire d'un Doctorat en informatique (ou discipline proche) obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date d'embauche.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE :

Rejoindre IMT Atlantique sur le projet NET4AI, c'est choisir un environnement où l'excellence académique rencontre les enjeux technologiques les plus actuels de l'IA générative:

🚀 Un défi technologique majeur : Participez à la construction d'infrastructures de recherche de pointe (SLICES-RI) pour optimiser les modèles GenAI de demain.

🤝 Un écosystème collaboratif unique : Travaillez au cœur d'un consortium multi-partenaires stimulant, mêlant expertise académique de haut niveau et innovation industrielle.

🌍 Impact et Open Source : Contribuez directement à des logiciels libres et à une science ouverte et reproductible, garantissant une visibilité internationale à vos travaux.

🍃 Qualité de vie et engagement : Évoluez sur un campus dynamique offrant un cadre de travail privilégié et des conditions favorisant l'équilibre vie pro/vie perso.

🚴‍♂️ Forfait mobilité durable (pour le covoiturage ou les trajets en vélo)

jobs.title: Data & AI Engineer Intern (6 months)
Avionics Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

Avionics Architecture & Hardware Design

  • Design, develop, and integrate avionics and electronic subsystems for high-performance unmanned aerial systems

  • Own schematic capture, PCB layout reviews, and component selection for flight-critical electronics, with a strong focus on size, weight, power, and cost

  • Define the electrical architecture, power distribution, and harnessing for compact, high-dynamic airframes

  • Select and integrate flight controllers, navigation sensors (IMU, GNSS, magnetometer, air data), data links, and onboard compute

  • Design for manufacturability and reliability, from early prototypes through to series production

Integration, Test & Validation

  • Lead bench, hardware-in-the-loop, and environmental testing of avionics subsystems

  • Integrate electronics into the airframe and support full system integration with the software and guidance teams

  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, power, signal integrity, and EMI/EMC issues

  • Support ground and flight test campaigns, analyse test data, and feed results back into rapid design iterations

Suppliers & Industrialisation

  • Work with component suppliers to secure quality, cost, and lead times

  • Manage component obsolescence, second-sourcing, and supply chain resilience for critical parts

  • Produce and maintain design documentation, BOMs, interface control documents, and test procedures

  • Support qualification activities against relevant aerospace and military standards

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Software, Guidance & Navigation, Mechanical, Product and Flight Test teams in short iteration loops

  • Contribute to design reviews, trade studies, and product roadmap decisions

  • Support field deployments and live demonstrations with customers when required

Requirements

Candidate profile

  • MSc or equivalent in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field

  • 3-8 years of experience in avionics, embedded hardware, or electronics design, ideally on UAS, aircraft, missiles, or other airborne systems

  • Hands-on experience taking boards from schematic to tested flight hardware

  • Solid understanding of power electronics, motor control, RF and data links, and sensor interfaces

  • Familiarity with autopilot ecosystems (PX4, ArduPilot, or proprietary) is a strong plus

Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on, lab-oriented mindset: at ease with an oscilloscope, a soldering iron, and a test bench

  • Rigorous, structured problem solver able to deliver under tight timelines

  • Able to make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, cost, and schedule

  • Clear technical communicator in documentation and design reviews

  • High integrity, discretion, and understanding of security culture

  • Fluent English; French is a plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a defense startup, neoprime, or fast-moving hardware environment

  • Knowledge of MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, DO-160, or equivalent standards

  • Embedded firmware experience (C/C++) on STM32 or similar microcontrollers

  • Experience integrating edge compute modules (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson) and high-bandwidth data links

  • Exposure to counter-UAS or air defense systems

  • Willingness to travel to test ranges and field sites

jobs.title: M&A & Equity Financing Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary 

As our M&A & Equity Financing Legal Counsel, you will work directly under the Head of M&A and Finance Legal Counsel, based in Paris. In close collaboration with our Business and Finance teams, you will play a key role in structuring, drafting and negotiating Mistral’s external growth transactions and equity fundraisings.


Mistral operates at the frontier of AI, where the pace of innovation demands transaction execution speed and precision that match the technology itself. You will help shape the growth and business relationships that will define Mistral’s next chapter.

Key responsibilities

  • Draft, negotiate and advise on a wide range of M&A transactions, including acquisitions, acqui-hires and other internal or external growth projects worldwide.

  • Take an active part in every stage of M&A transactions: deal structuring, due diligence, negotiations, signing and closing.

  • Coordinate the process for Mistral’s equity fundraisings, including legal communication with prospective investors, structuring the company's due diligence disclosure, drafting investment documentation and leading the signing and closing of equity fundraisings.

  • Coordinate and assist on Mistral’s secondary sale transactions on behalf of investors and employees.

  • Draft, negotiate, and advise on transaction documentation, including LOIs, NDAs, SPAs, shareholders' agreements, investment agreements, and other ancillary transaction documents.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including other corporate functions.

  • Build internal templates, practices, and guidelines for M&A and equity financing documentation.

  • Support on other legal topics as needed, particularly on compliance matters related to corporate affairs.

Qualifications and skills

  • Bachelor's degree or above (LLB, LLM or Juris Doctor preferred) from an accredited law school in France or another EU country. Admission to practice law in at least one additional jurisdiction, in particular the USA or the UK, would be a plus.

  • A minimum of 4–5 years of relevant legal experience, including at least 3 years at an international law firm.

  • Substantial experience in M&A, VC and/or equity financing transactions, including hands-on experience working on large- to mid-cap acquisitions, from due diligence through signing and closing.

  • Familiarity with VC/PE-type transaction documentation is highly valued: you understand complex shareholders’ agreements, management and employee incentive packages, as well as the governance dynamics of venture-backed and PE-backed companies.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in both English and French, with a strong ability to present complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders.

  • Knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing and their applications.

  • Adaptability: proactive, flexible, eager to learn and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ethical awareness: a strong understanding of ethical considerations related to AI, such as fairness, transparency, accountability, and bias mitigation.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche classé dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, recrute un ou une Gestionnaire financier et comptable (F/H).

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

 

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Agence comptable. Ce service comprend cinq personnels. Il a pour vocation de participer à la tenue de la comptabilité générale, procéder aux paiements et aux encaissements et contrôler les opérations budgétaires.

La/le titulaire du poste sera affecté, sur le Campus de Brest ou le Campus de Paris-Saclay.

 

Missions / Activités principales :

Sous l’autorité de l’agent comptable, le/la titulaire du poste a pour missions de :

 

  • Assurer le visa des recettes

  • Procéder aux relances et au recouvrement des recettes

  • Assurer le visa de la paye

 

Missions / Activité annexe :

  • Assurer le visa de la dépense

  • Procéder au suivi et au remboursement des cautions

  • Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues.

  • Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités

  • Participer aux travaux préparatoires de contrôle interne comptable (CIC)

 

L’équipe de l’Agence comptable étant bilocalisée, des trajets entre Paris-Saclay et Brest seront à prévoir dans le cadre des activités du service.

jobs.description:
Hi! I'm Hannah and I lead the HRBP Team here at Ashby. I joined over four years ago as the first People hire, and I'm excited that our team is expanding! The People Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently; we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success.

We review all applications, and there's no benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look over the application questions, and please submit before the application deadline! We can't take calls outside the interview process, so reaching out to the team won't move your application forward.

Role overview:
We're looking for an experienced, UK-based HR Business Partner (HRBP) to play a key role in supporting Ashby’s next phase of growth and to be Ashby's first dedicated HR presence in EMEA. You'll be the go-to People partner for our EMEA leaders and employees. You'll bring the local expertise we need around UK employment law, benefits, employee relations, and entity compliance, and you'll work closely with our US-based HR Business Partners, who also support teams in the region. Building strong relationships, getting the details right, and creating a great employee experience should all be equally important to you.

As our HRBP for EMEA, you'll translate business objectives into a people strategy that fits how Ashby operates in the region. You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and work closely with our wider People team, while also diving into the details to make sure our processes and procedures run smoothly. We're a growing startup, so there's a lot to accomplish! You'll move easily between strategic projects and administrative tasks and support the team wherever it's needed. In this role, you'll join a high-impact team that is rethinking how People Ops can and should work, while shaping an exceptional workplace culture for our global team.

Role requirements:

  • UK employment expertise: You have deep, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law and practice, including contracts, benefits and pensions, leave, performance and separation processes, and workplace requirements. You know when to partner with external counsel and advisors, and you help us reduce risk while staying true to how Ashby operates.

  • Strategic HR partner: At your core, you build strong relationships with leaders and earn credibility and trust as a strategic partner. You proactively assess team, manager, and company needs, make recommendations, and put solutions in place.

  • People Operations Expertise: You bring broad knowledge of People Ops and HR, including compensation, benefits, performance management, and compliance, and you're happy to roll up your sleeves on projects outside your core remit.

  • Multi-country and entity support: You've supported employees across multiple EMEA countries and understand how working through an entity differs from working through an EOR. You're ready to help as we expand our footprint.

  • Strategic Thinking: You have the ability to translate business objectives into actionable people strategies

  • Strong Communicator: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively convey information to all stakeholders and have the ability to present and facilitate discussions clearly and confidently.

  • Compensation Expertise: You have experience using compensation market data to develop and maintain competitive, equitable compensation practices, with an understanding of how to apply market data across EMEA and other international regions.

  • Performance Management: You have deep experience building and evolving performance management practices. You are comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations and helping build scalable approaches that align with company culture and operating principles.

  • Training and Development: You have experience building and scaling internal training programs, specifically for management teams. You are comfortable facilitating topics to all levels of employees.

  • Employee Relations & Risk Management: You offer guidance to leaders in managing sensitive employee situations. As needed, you act as a mediator and investigate escalated issues. You stay up to date on legal requirements related to employment and regulatory compliance, partnering with legal counsel as needed to mitigate risk.

You could be a great fit if:

  • 💻 You have deep experience (~8 years) in HR or People Ops, ideally in a high-growth, scaling company

  • 🇬🇧 You're a UK-based HR generalist with strong expertise in UK employment law, benefits, and employee relations

  • 🌍 You've supported a globally distributed, asynchronous workforce across multiple EMEA countries

  • 🔑 You take real ownership. You move work forward on your own, keep the right people in the loop, and see things through

  • 🧭 You're a principled thinker who wants to understand why things work the way they do before deciding what should change

  • 📣 You communicate clearly and directly, with strengths in coaching, facilitation, and policy development

  • 🔄 You are flexible in your approach and avoid rigid adherence to past playbooks or overly process-heavy solutions.

  • ⚡️ You're energized by a fast-paced environment with a mix of strategic and hands-on work

  • 🤝 Handling complex employee relations issues is one of your strengths

  • ⚙️ Continuous Improvement is core to how you operate. You're detail-oriented and always looking for ways to improve People Ops processes and documentation

  • 🔍 You've used HRIS, compensation tools, and other HR systems to drive operational excellence

Bonus points if you have:

  • An advanced degree in HR, business, or organizational development

  • CIPD qualification (Level 5 or 7) or an equivalent HR certification

This role may not be a fit if:

  • You’re looking to simply bring processes or programs from previous roles and implement them here. While past experience is valuable, you'll need to apply principled thinking to assess what would work well for Ashby.

  • Working independently feels uncomfortable and you require a significant amount of guidance in how to perform your job.

  • Having difficult conversations with all levels of employees makes you uneasy

  • You shy away from ambiguity - preferring structured, pre-defined assignments.

  • You prefer working with a single team instead of multiple teams.

Interview process
Our interview process is thorough. We want to make sure everyone who joins is the right fit for Ashby, and we'll give you plenty of information to decide whether Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is:

  • Recruiter screen with the Talent Acquisition team (30 minutes)

  • People Ops team interview (45 minutes)

  • Take-home assignment (1 hour)

  • People Leader interview (45 minutes)

jobs.company_name: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
jobs.description:
Hello!

I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉

We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being its first Support Engineer across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

Not sure which Support role is right for you?

We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles.

  • Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

  • Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

About the role

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As Ashby’s first Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

What you’ll own

  • Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

  • Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

  • Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

  • Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

  • Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

  • Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

You should apply if:

  • You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

  • You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

  • You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

  • You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

  • You want to be the first technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.

You should not apply if:

  • You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

  • Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting.

  • You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself.

  • You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes.

  • You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions.

  • You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works.

About Ashby

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com.

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

Interview process

Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership.

  • Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min

  • Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete

  • Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min

  • Virtual onsite — 120 min

    • Meet the team — 30 min

    • Technical & integration skills — 45 min

    • CS and Support leadership — 30 min

    • Closing questions — 15 min

Onboarding

Your onboarding will combine Ashby-wide product and company training with a Support Engineering-specific ramp plan. You’ll learn the product and support workflow, get familiar with the tools and systems used for technical investigations, and build relationships across Support, Product, and Engineering. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget.

  • A one-time $2,000 home-office setup budget for furniture, monitors, peripherals, and ergonomic equipment, plus a company-provided laptop.

  • Opportunities to spend time with teammates through an annual company offsite, team offsites, local meetups, and virtual events.

  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

Software Engineer Intern - Industrialization
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.
 
We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.
 
This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.
 
 

The Opportunity

You will join the Industrialization team, the group that turns ANYmal from something engineers can build into something a factory can build, test, and release at volume. Every robot that leaves our production line passes through the test systems this team owns. When those tests are effective, quality issues are caught in Zurich before reaching a customer's industrial site. That is the leverage of this role.Sitting directly at the intersection of software and hardware, you will write Python code to interface with physical devices, help define reliable pass/fail criteria for ANYmal subsystems, and deploy test routines to our manufacturing shopfloor. Working alongside Manufacturing Engineers, test technicians, and hardware design teams, you will gain hands-on experience bridging cutting-edge robotics design with scalable industrial production.
 
 

The Market & Our Technology


ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Founded as an ETH Zurich spin-off, we build autonomous mobile robots (ANYmal) that solve complex inspection tasks in challenging industrial environments such as energy, chemical, and mining facilities. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people in Zurich and work on cutting-edge robot technology that is transforming industrial operations globally.

Your Impact
  • Develop, test, and help deploy Python-based automated test procedures for ANYmal hardware subsystems
  • Instrument and control hardware devices, sensors, and cameras directly through software interfaces
  • Collaborate with test technicians and manufacturing engineers to refine shopfloor testing workflows
  • Learn to write clean, resilient, and reproducible code using established software engineering best practices
  • Contribute directly to test documentation and technician procedures to ensure seamless shopfloor execution

    • Your Profile
  • Ongoing or recently completed degree (BSc or MSc) in Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering
  • Solid Python programming foundation with experience building projects that interact with hardware, sensors, or external APIs
  • Practical hands-on experience with hardware interfaces through university labs, student projects, or personal builds
  • Structured approach to problem-solving and a keen interest in measurement fundamentals like tolerances and repeatability
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable explaining technical concepts and drafting structured procedures
  • Proactive mindset with a desire to learn quickly, ask questions early, and work in a hands-on production environment
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich, with a commitment to regular on-site presence near the hardware and shopfloor

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience with ROS or ROS2
  • Basic understanding of image processing or computer vision pipelines (OpenCV)
  • Exposure to sensor calibration techniques (IMU, camera intrinsics/extrinsics, depth, or thermal)
  • Familiarity with Docker or devcontainer environments
  • Background in student engineering teams such as Formula Student, Swissloop, or ARIS Rocketry, especially on testing or integration
    • Internship Details:
     
    Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month
    Duration: 6 months 
    Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)
     
    Who can apply:
    EU applicants for internships
    The internship can be voluntary
    A work permit is not required but the candidate needs a residence permit
    Must be enrolled in a University
     
    Non-EU applicants for internships:
    Internship must be mandatory (supported by a letter from a university)
    A work permit is required
    Must reside in CH
     
     
    Interested? Submit your application
    We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.
     
    What We Offer:
    - Hands-on experience working on advanced locomotion software.
    - Mentorship from industry experts.
    - Opportunities to contribute to innovative projects.
    - A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
    - Potential for future full-time opportunities.
     
    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive and fun environment in the city of Zurich.

jobs.description:
Über tonies:

tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat die Art und Weise, wie kleine Kinder unabhängig spielen und lernen, durch seinen kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz verändert. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert, und das Portfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht, darunter die Börsennotierung an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein global aufgestelltes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren.

Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, an einer inspirierenden Mission mitzuwirken: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie.


Du als Teil von tonies:

Bei Tonies Licensing haben wir es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Magie von Audio zu Kindern überall auf der Welt zu bringen. Wir suchen eine motivierte und begeisterte Studentische Nachwuchskraft (m/w/d), die unser Portfolio an globalen Lizenzkonten unterstützt und dabei hilft, internationale Lizenzprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Produktlaunch voranzutreiben. Diese Rolle ist perfekt für jemanden, der wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem kommerziell ausgerichteten Umfeld sammeln möchte – an der Seite eines Teams, das Beziehungen zu großen internationalen Lizenzgebern der Spielzeug- und Unterhaltungsbranche in Nordamerika und der EMEA-Region betreut.


Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

  • Unterstützung im Lizenzmanagement: Du unterstützt das Lizenz-Team bei der Pflege und Koordination der Beziehungen zu internationalen Lizenzpartnern.
  • Mitarbeit an internationalen Projekten: Du begleitest internationale Lizenzprojekte über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von den ersten Gesprächen über den Vertragsabschluss bis hin zur Produktentwicklung und dem Marktstart.
  • Kaufmännische Unterstützung: Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Pflege von Lizenz-GuVs (Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen) und unterstützt bei der Ausarbeitung von Berichten sowie Präsentationen für interne Stakeholder.
  • Schnittstellenkoordination: Du unterstützt die Kommunikation zwischen internen Fachbereichen (z. B. Produktentwicklung, Marketing, Recht, Finanzen) und externen Lizenzagenturen oder -partnern.
  • Markt- & Branchenrecherche: Du recherchierst aktuelle Trends sowie Entwicklungen in der globalen Lizenz- und Unterhaltungsbranche und bereitest die Ergebnisse für das Team auf.


Was wir uns von dir wünschen:

  • Studium: Immatrikulierte/r Student/in, idealerweise in Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), Medienmanagement, Kommunikationswissenschaften oder einem verwandten Studiengang.

jobs.title: Principal AI/ML Scientist & Engineer
jobs.description:
We believe it takes great people to create a great product. That’s why our team lives our company values, and we hire based on them, too. Since 2010, Pipedrive has been on a mission to support sales and marketing teams with easy-to-use, powerful tools that make everyday work faster and easier. Today, our cloud-based software is trusted by over 100,000 companies and used in 179 countries. We have grown from a five-person team to a truly international company of over 850+ people, representing more than 50 nationalities, with ten offices distributed across Europe and the US. In 2020, Pipedrive received a majority investment from Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that invests exclusively in enterprise software, data and technology-enabled businesses, making Pipedrive the fifth unicorn from Estonia.


We are looking for a Principal AI/ML Scientist & Engineer to lead a growing team of Applied Scientists and AI/ML Engineers. This is a role for a pragmatic "Builder-Scientist" - a technical leader who possesses deep scientific rigor but is fundamentally driven by the iterative shipping of data products that customers fall in love with. You will lead the technical strategy for AI/ML-based solutions designed to extract value from both structured and unstructured data, bridging the gap between advanced research and production-grade systems. Your impact will be measured through technical leadership, leverage, and the real-world business outcomes you enable.
 

Your new adventure:
  • Lead and mentor a team of Applied Scientists and AI/ML Engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and scientific rigor
  • Lead the technical strategy for AI/ML-based solutions focused on extracting actionable value and insights from both structured CRM data and unstructured content
  • Build the intelligence within our AI-native CRM, including the design of autonomous agentic workflows and real-time reasoning engines that execute business actions safely at scale
  • Partner closely with the AI Platform team to drive the overarching strategy for large language model operations (LLMOps), ensuring infrastructure supports efficient experimentation and robust deployment
  • Apply deep scientific intuition to the design of AI systems, ensuring that models and data-intensive solutions are optimized for customer centricity and real-world performance
  • Act as a technical authority and multiplier across the AI/ML and data ecosystem, shaping the AI engineering roadmap and setting the bar for how we leverage the modern AI stack

  • Proven ability to lead and scale a technical team, with experience mentoring senior talent and raising the technical bar of an organization
  • Deep expertise in modern AI engineering concepts and tech stacks, with hands-on experience in agentic system orchestration (e.g., LangGraph), RAG architectures, and vector databases
  • You are a deep scientist by training but a builder by choice; you prioritize shipping working, iterative solutions that solve real customer problems over chasing theoretical perfection
  • Proven track record of delivering customer and business value through simple and complex AI/ML-based solutions at scale
  • Broad exposure to ML, Deep Learning, and AI; you understand the practical trade-offs between different models and agentic frameworks
  • Excellent product sense and business awareness, with the ability to translate technical and scientific choices into tangible improvements for our users
  • Ability to lead through influence and technical authority, partnering with platform teams to influence strategy and raise the collective technical bar
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), distributed systems, container orchestration, data engineering (batch pipeline, feature store, Kafka)

    • Why Pipedrive?

  • We’ve got you – Your well-being matters. Enjoy flexible hours, wellness perks and SWAG. Think performance-based bonuses, 28 paid leave days, well-being days, compassionate leave, and even pawternal leave—because we take care of ourselves and our people
  • Grow with us – Whether through mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility, we invest in helping you unlock your potential. Open, honest feedback and clear communication are at our core. We grow together through trust and accountability
  • Packed with purpose – Help 100,000+ small and medium-sized businesses grow and succeed while doing meaningful, customer-driven work

jobs.title: Chief of Staff Go to Market (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Your mission

Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. As Chief of Staff to the Go-to-Market Director, you are the operational backbone that keeps the go-to-market engine running at full speed across all markets. You own the details, the data, and the day-to-day execution, freeing the Go-to-Market Director to focus on strategy and the bigger picture, while you make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • You own the operational rhythm of the Go-to-Market Director's agenda, translating strategic priorities into concrete plans, timelines, and next-day action items.
  • You track performance data and KPIs across all markets, spotting issues early and surfacing clear, decision-ready insights before being asked.
  • You bring structure to ambiguity, designing the project management architecture, systems, and processes that keep complex, multi-market initiatives moving without anything getting lost.
  • You proactively identify what needs to happen next, take ownership of it end to end, and know when to bring in the Go-to-Market Director to support or guide.
  • You prepare briefings, reports, and presentations that turn complex data into clear narratives for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • You coordinate closely with Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing across markets, following up on commitments and ensuring cross-functional initiatives stay on track.
  • You act as a trusted right hand, representing the Go-to-Market Director's priorities accurately in conversations and correspondence.
  • You constantly look for ways to improve how the Go-to-Market function operates, bringing structure and rigour to a fast-moving, scaling environment.


Your profile

  • You bring at least 3 to 5 years of experience in a Chief of Staff, business operations, analyst, or similar high-rigour role, ideally within tech, scale-ups, or energy.

  • You are exceptionally detail-oriented and accurate, with a natural instinct for catching what others miss.

  • You are proactive by nature: you don't wait to be told what to do, you anticipate what's needed, take initiative, and only ask for help or authority when it genuinely matters.

  • You have strong project management skills, able to build the architecture and structure that keeps complex, multi-market projects on track.

  • You are highly structured and organised by default, able to juggle multiple workstreams and deadlines without losing the thread.

  • You are strong with data and analytics, comfortable turning numbers into clear, actionable insight.

  • You are a fast, reliable executor who thrives on turning big-picture priorities into next-day, on-the-ground action.

  • Fluency in German and English (C1/C2) is required, written and verbal.


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time
